title.raw: 卷324 列傳一百十一 方观承 富明安 周元理 李湖 李瀚 李世杰 袁守侗 郑大进 刘峨 陆燿 管幹贞 蒋兆奎 胡季堂

sentences.zh: 列傳一百十一

translations.literal: Biographies 111
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 111

sentences.zh: =方觀承=方觀承，字遐穀，安徽桐城人。

translations.literal: Fang Guancheng, styled Xiagu, was a native of Tongcheng in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guancheng, whose style was Xiagu, came from Tongcheng in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 祖登嶧，官工部主事。

translations.literal: His grandfather Dengfeng served as a director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Dengfeng had been a director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 父式濟，康熙四十八年進士，官內閣中書。

translations.literal: His father Shiji, a jinshi of the forty-eighth year of Kangxi, served as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shiji, who had passed the jinshi examination in the forty-eighth year of the Kangxi reign, served as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 僑居江寧，坐戴名世南山集獄，並戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: The family lived in Jiangning; implicated in the Dai Mingshi Nanshanji case, both were banished to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The family had settled in Jiangning; caught up in the Dai Mingshi Nanshanji affair, grandfather and father were both sent into exile on the Heilongjiang frontier.

sentences.zh: 觀承尚少，寄食清涼山寺。

translations.literal: Guancheng was still young and lived on charity at Qingliangshan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng was still a boy and depended on charity at Qingliangshan Temple.

sentences.zh: 歲與兄觀永徒步至塞外營養，往來南北，枵腹重趼。

translations.literal: Each year he and his elder brother Guanyong walked on foot to the frontier to support their elders, traveling north and south on empty stomachs with feet covered in calluses.
translations.idiomatic: Every year he and his elder brother Guanyong walked to the frontier camps to support their banished kin, shuttling north and south on empty stomachs and blistered feet.

sentences.zh: 數年，祖與父皆沒，益困。

translations.literal: After several years both grandfather and father died, and their hardship grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years both grandfather and father died, and their poverty deepened.

sentences.zh: 然因是具知南北阨塞及民情土俗所宜，厲志勤學，為平郡王福彭所知。

translations.literal: Yet through this he came thoroughly to know the strategic passes north and south and what suited local customs; he resolved to study diligently and was noticed by the Prince of Ping, Fupeng.
translations.idiomatic: Yet those journeys gave him a firsthand grasp of northern and southern passes, local conditions, and what policies would fit; he applied himself to study and won the notice of the Prince of Ping, Fupeng.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，福彭以定邊大將軍率師討準噶爾，奏為記室。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yongzheng, Fupeng, as Pacification Commissioner on the Frontier, led an army against the Dzungars and recommended him as staff secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Yongzheng, Fupeng marched against the Dzungars as frontier pacification commissioner and had Guancheng appointed his staff secretary.

sentences.zh: 世宗召入對，賜中書銜。

translations.literal: The Yongzheng Emperor summoned him for an audience and granted him the rank of Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor called him in for an audience and conferred the rank of Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 師還，授內閣中書。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，充軍機處章京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he served as a clerk in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong he became a clerk in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 累遷吏部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted in stages to director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 七年，授直隸清河道。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Qinghe Circuit intendant of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made Qinghe Circuit intendant in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 署總督史貽直奏勘永定河工，上諭之曰：「方觀承不穿鑿而有條理，可與詳酌。」

translations.literal: Acting Governor Shi Yizhi memorialized on inspecting Yongding River works; the emperor instructed him: "Fang Guancheng is not pedantic yet is methodical; you may consult with him in detail."
translations.idiomatic: When Acting Governor Shi Yizhi reported on inspecting Yongding River works, the emperor told him, "Fang Guancheng is practical without being fussy and thinks in an orderly way—work the details out with him."

sentences.zh: 八年，遷按察使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九年，命大學士訥親勘浙江海塘及山東、江南河道，以觀承從。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Grand Secretary Neqin was ordered to inspect the Zhejiang seawall and the waterways of Shandong and Jiangnan, with Guancheng accompanying him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Grand Secretary Neqin was sent to inspect the Zhejiang seawall and the river works of Shandong and Jiangnan, and Guancheng went with him.

sentences.zh: 尋擢布政使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as acting governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he acted as governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十二年，回布政使任。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he returned to his post as provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he resumed his post as provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he became governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十四年，擢直隸總督，兼理河道。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to governor-general of Zhili and given concurrent charge of river conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was raised to governor-general of Zhili with concurrent responsibility for river works.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he received the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十年，加太子太保，署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was given the additional title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and served as acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and acted as governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，回直隸任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he returned to his Zhili post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he returned to his post in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 觀承撫山東時，議以安山湖畀民承墾昇科，奏言：「湖中尚有積水，但二麥布種於水已涸之後，收穫於水未發之先。

translations.literal: When Guancheng governed Shandong, it was proposed to let the people reclaim Anshan Lake and raise it to taxable land; he memorialized: "The lake still holds standing water, yet winter wheat and cloth seed are sown after the water has dried and harvested before the water rises again.
translations.idiomatic: While governing Shandong, Guancheng opposed a plan to hand Anshan Lake to farmers for reclamation and taxation. He wrote, "Water still pools in the lake, yet farmers sow their winter wheat and cotton only after it has drained and harvest before the floods return.

sentences.zh: 故雖有水患，民原承墾昇科。

translations.literal: Thus although there are flood hazards, the people are willing to reclaim the land and have it taxed.
translations.idiomatic: So despite the flood risk, the people were willing to reclaim the land and pay tax on it.

sentences.zh: 昇科後，官徵民納，例重秋收。

translations.literal: After it is brought under the tax rolls, the government collects and the people pay, with levies weighted toward the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Once the land was taxed, collection fell heaviest on the autumn crop.

sentences.zh: 秋禾被水，請蠲、請賑、請豁，徒致紛繁。

translations.literal: When autumn grain is drowned, petitions for remission, relief, and exemption follow one after another, causing endless confusion.
translations.idiomatic: When autumn grain was flooded, there would be endless petitions for remission, relief, and write-offs.

sentences.zh: 即如南旺湖，亦經台臣條奏畀民承墾。

translations.literal: Even Nanwang Lake had been proposed by censorial officials for reclamation by the people.
translations.idiomatic: Nanwang Lake, for example, had likewise been proposed for farmer reclamation by censorial officials.

sentences.zh: 臣從訥親履勘，見卑處水涸，高處如屋如岩，意謂水不能及。

translations.literal: Your servant followed Neqin on an on-site inspection and saw low places dry while high places rose like houses and cliffs; one might think the water could not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: When I accompanied Neqin on inspection, the low ground looked dry and the high ground like houses and cliffs, so one might think the floods would never reach it.

sentences.zh: 臣至山​​東，方知夏秋間運河及汶水暴漲，賴以分減，運道得保無虞。

translations.literal: When your servant reached Shandong, he learned that in summer and autumn the Grand Canal and the Wen River swell violently and rely on these lakes to divide and reduce the flow, so the transport route remains secure.
translations.idiomatic: Only after I reached Shandong did I see that in summer and autumn the Grand Canal and Wen River surge violently and depend on these lakes to spill off excess water and keep the transport route safe.

sentences.zh: 凡大川所經，眾水所注，其宣洩瀦蓄之區，恆閱數年、數十年，有若閒置，一旦實得其用，未可以目前忘久遠。

translations.literal: Wherever great rivers pass and many streams pour in, the areas for discharge and storage may seem idle for years or decades, yet once they truly serve their purpose one must not forget the long term for the sake of the present.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever major rivers run and tributaries gather, flood storage may look unused for years or decades—yet when it is finally needed, present convenience must not blind us to the long view.

sentences.zh: 安山湖亦運河洩水地，應視南旺湖例，夏麥秋禾，分季收租。

translations.literal: Anshan Lake is also a spillway for the Grand Canal; it should follow the Nanwang Lake precedent, with summer wheat and autumn grain taxed by season.
translations.idiomatic: Anshan Lake is likewise a canal spill basin and should follow Nanwang Lake: tax summer wheat and autumn grain by season.

sentences.zh: 除去昇科名目，應徵、應免，悉從其宜。

translations.literal: Remove the category of permanent tax registration; what should be levied or exempted should all follow what is appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Drop the permanent tax-registration label and levy or exempt as local conditions require.

sentences.zh: 國利而民亦不病。」

translations.literal: The state would benefit and the people would not suffer."
translations.idiomatic: The state would gain revenue without harming the people."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「義倉與社倉同為積貯，但社倉例惟藉種，義倉則藉與賑兼行，而尤重在賑。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Charity granaries and community granaries alike store grain, but community granaries by rule only lend seed, whereas charity granaries both lend and relieve, with relief especially important.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that charity granaries and community granaries both stored grain, but community granaries only lent seed whereas charity granaries both lent and gave relief—and relief mattered most.

sentences.zh: 設倉宜在鄉不宜在城，積穀宜在民不宜在官。

translations.literal: Granaries should be set up in the countryside rather than in cities, and grain should be stored among the people rather than held by officials.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries should stand in the countryside, not the county seat, and grain should stay with the people rather than in official hands.

sentences.zh: 秋穫告豐，勸導輸納，歲終將穀數奏明，不必開具管收除在。

translations.literal: When the autumn harvest is abundant, encourage contributions; at year's end report the amount of grain without drawing up detailed receipts of intake, custody, and disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: After a good autumn harvest, encourage donations; at year's end report totals without burdensome intake-and-disbursement ledgers.

sentences.zh: 則其數不在官，法可行久。」

translations.literal: Then the amounts would not rest with officials and the system could endure."
translations.idiomatic: If the figures were not held by officials, the system could last."

sentences.zh: 撫浙江，海塘引河出中小亹安流，北大亹沙漲成陸。

translations.literal: As governor of Zhejiang, the seawall diversion channel flowed out through the middle and small shoals in peace, while the northern great shoal silted up into dry land.
translations.idiomatic: As Zhejiang governor, he found the seawall diversion running safely through the middle and lesser shoals while the northern great shoal had silted into dry land.

sentences.zh: 觀承履勘，丈出地三十五萬餘畝，畀民承墾。

translations.literal: Guancheng inspected on site, surveyed more than 350,000 mu of land, and let the people reclaim it.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng surveyed the ground in person, measured out more than 350,000 mu, and opened it to farmer reclamation.

sentences.zh: 又以引河既出中小亹，民間失地，以附近村地二萬餘畝撥補。

translations.literal: Because the diversion now passed through the middle and small shoals, private land was lost; more than 20,000 mu of nearby village land was allotted to compensate.
translations.idiomatic: Because the new channel cut through the middle shoals, farmers lost land; he allocated more than 20,000 mu from nearby villages to make them whole.

sentences.zh: 复察各地咸氣未除，民不能即耕，令灶戶以未種地交民承佃，使灶戶得租，貧民得地。

translations.literal: He further found that salinity had not yet cleared in various places and the people could not farm at once; he ordered salt producers to lease unused land to the people so the producers would receive rent and the poor would gain land.
translations.idiomatic: Where salinity still barred immediate farming, he had salt producers lease unused plots to poor farmers so producers kept rent income and the needy gained land.

sentences.zh: 分疏以聞，上嘉之。

translations.literal: He reported each measure separately; the emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He reported each measure separately, and the emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 督直隸二十年，治績彰顯。

translations.literal: He governed Zhili for twenty years with outstanding achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Over twenty years as Zhili governor-general his administrative record stood out.

sentences.zh: 以兼理河道，治水尤著勞勚。

translations.literal: Because he also managed river conservancy, his labor in controlling water was especially notable.
translations.idiomatic: With concurrent charge of river works, his efforts in flood control were especially distinguished.

sentences.zh: 直隸五大河，永定河渾流最難治。

translations.literal: Of Zhili's five great rivers, the muddy current of the Yongding was hardest to control.
translations.idiomatic: Among Zhili's five major rivers, the Yongding's muddy torrent was the hardest to tame.

sentences.zh: 觀承初上官，即疏言：「永定河自六工以下，河形高仰，請就舊有北大堤改移下口，庶水行地中，暢下無阻。」

translations.literal: Soon after taking office Guancheng memorialized: "Below the sixth works section the Yongding River bed rises high; I request shifting the lower outlet along the existing northern great dike so the water may run within the channel and flow down without obstruction."
translations.idiomatic: Soon after taking office he argued that below the sixth works the Yongding ran unnaturally high and asked to shift the lower outlet along the existing northern dike so water could run in-channel and drain freely.

sentences.zh: 上諭以「改移下口不可輕言」。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed that "shifting the lower outlet must not be spoken of lightly."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that shifting the lower outlet was not to be proposed lightly.

sentences.zh: 明年春，上臨視永定河堤，御製詩示觀承，大指謂河堤但可培厚，不可加高；

translations.literal: The next spring the emperor inspected the Yongding dikes in person and composed a poem for Guancheng, stating in essence that dikes may only be thickened, not raised;
translations.idiomatic: The next spring the emperor inspected the Yongding dikes in person and sent Guancheng an imperial poem saying, in essence, that dikes should be thickened, not raised;

sentences.zh: 略移下口，取易於趨下，亦補偏救弊之策。

translations.literal: slightly shifting the lower outlet to make descent easier was also a remedy to correct defects.
translations.idiomatic: and that slightly shifting the lower outlet to ease the descent was likewise a corrective measure.

sentences.zh: 是夏，永定河南岸三工汙溝奪溜。

translations.literal: That summer a sewage ditch at the third works on the Yongding's south bank seized the current.
translations.idiomatic: That summer a sewage ditch at the third works on the south bank diverted the Yongding's current.

sentences.zh: 上以江南河道總督高斌豆瓣集漫口圖示觀承，觀承奏：「豆瓣集為中河餘水漫溢，故可於水緩處施工。

translations.literal: The emperor showed Guancheng Gao Bin's diagram of the Doubanji breach on the Jiangnan waterways; Guancheng memorialized: "Doubanji was overflow from surplus water in the middle channel, so work could be done where the current was slow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor showed him Governor-General Gao Bin's plan for the Doubanji breach in Jiangnan; Guancheng replied that Doubanji was merely surplus from the middle channel and could be repaired where the current slackened.

sentences.zh: 永定河若但堵月堤，溢水無歸路。

translations.literal: On the Yongding, if one only blocks the crescent dike, the overflow has no outlet.
translations.idiomatic: On the Yongding, merely plugging the crescent dike would leave floodwater nowhere to go.

sentences.zh: 仍塞漫口，偪溜入引河，復故道。」

translations.literal: One should still block the breach, force the current into the diversion channel, and restore the old course."
translations.idiomatic: He should still close the breach, drive the current back into the diversion channel, and restore the old course.

sentences.zh: 上韙之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 又明年春，疏言：「永定河下口掣溜出冰窖壩口。

translations.literal: The next spring he memorialized: "The lower Yongding outlet has shifted its current to the Bingjiao dam mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring he reported that the Yongding's lower outlet had shifted to the Bingjiao dam mouth.

sentences.zh: 請即於坦坡埝尾東北斜穿三角淀，開引河入葉淀，自鳳河轉入大清河。」

translations.literal: I request immediately cutting diagonally northeast from the end of the Tanpo embankment through Sanjiao Marsh, opening a diversion into Ye Marsh, and entering the Daqing River by way of the Feng River."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to cut a diversion northeast from the Tanpo embankment through Sanjiao Marsh into Ye Marsh and then via the Feng River into the Daqing River.

sentences.zh: 廷議以時初過凌汛，慮盛漲浹沙淤淀，令觀承覆奏。

translations.literal: Court discussion held that the season had just passed the ice-flood period and feared that a great rise would carry sand and silt the marshes; Guancheng was ordered to reply again.
translations.idiomatic: Court debate noted that the ice-flood season had only just ended and feared summer floods would dump silt into the marshes, and ordered Guancheng to respond again.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「冰窖壩口掣溜，在上七工尾，低於正河丈二三尺。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The current shifting at Bingjiao is at the tail of the upper seventh works, one or two zhang lower than the main channel.
translations.idiomatic: He replied that the shift at Bingjiao lay at the tail of the upper seventh works, one or two zhang below the main channel.

sentences.zh: 南距南坦坡，北距北大堤，有漫衍而無衝溢，此地勢之順也。

translations.literal: South of the southern Tanpo slope and north of the northern great dike, the water spreads without violent overflow—this accords with the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Bounded south by the southern Tanpo slope and north by the northern great dike, the water could spread without violent overflow—terrain favored the change.

sentences.zh: 水由壩出，非衝決亦非開放，民情不怨，此人事之順也。

translations.literal: The water issues from the dam mouth neither by breach nor by deliberate opening; the people do not complain—this accords with human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Water was leaving through the dam mouth neither by breach nor by forced opening, and the people were not protesting—human factors also favored it.

sentences.zh: 凌汛改移，經理有暇，此天時之順也。

translations.literal: To shift after the ice flood leaves time for management—this accords with the season.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting after the ice flood left time to manage the works—timing favored it as well.

sentences.zh: 今日必應改移，不復稍存歧見。

translations.literal: Today the shift must be made; I no longer harbor the slightest doubt.
translations.idiomatic: The shift had to be made now; he no longer had any doubt.

sentences.zh: 至慮盛漲梜沙淤淀，渾水至三十里外，水渙沙停，當無此慮。

translations.literal: As for the fear that a great rise would carry sand and silt the marshes, muddy water even thirty li out disperses and sand settles; there should be no such worry.
translations.idiomatic: As for fears that summer floods would silt the marshes, even thirty li out muddy water spreads and sand drops—there was little to fear.

sentences.zh: 且臣亦嘗計及，故不使東循龍尾直入鳳河，而引入葉淀，迂​​其途而廣其地，更可經久無患。」

translations.literal: Your servant had also considered this; therefore he did not let the current run east along Longwei straight into the Feng River but led it into Ye Marsh, lengthening the route and widening the area so it could endure without trouble."
translations.idiomatic: He had planned for this too: rather than send the current east along Longwei straight into the Feng River, he routed it through Ye Marsh, lengthening and widening the path so the works would last.

sentences.zh: 上命尚書舒赫德、河東總督顧琮會勘，如觀承議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Minister Shuhede and Hedong Governor-General Gu Cong to inspect jointly; they agreed with Guancheng's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Minister Shuhede and Hedong Governor-General Gu Cong to inspect together, and they endorsed Guancheng's plan.

sentences.zh: 自是永定河下口出冰窖。

translations.literal: From then on the lower Yongding outlet was at Bingjiao.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Yongding's lower outlet ran through Bingjiao.

sentences.zh: 居二年，复疏言：「永定河下口漸淤。

translations.literal: Two years later he again memorialized: "The lower Yongding outlet is gradually silting.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he reported that the lower Yongding outlet was silting up.

sentences.zh: 請於北岸六工尾開堤放水，至五道口，導歸沙家淀，仍自鳳河入大清河。」

translations.literal: I request opening the dike at the tail of the sixth works on the north bank to release water as far as Wudaokou, guiding it back to Shajia Marsh and still entering the Daqing River by the Feng River."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to breach the dike at the tail of the sixth works on the north bank, release water to Wudaokou, route it through Shajia Marsh, and again enter the Daqing River via the Feng River.

sentences.zh: 廷議以甫改冰窖下口，何以又請於北岸六工開堤放水，令觀承覆奏。

translations.literal: Court discussion asked why, having just shifted the outlet to Bingjiao, he now requested opening the dike at the sixth works on the north bank; Guancheng was ordered to reply again.
translations.idiomatic: Court debate asked why, having just moved the outlet to Bingjiao, he now wanted to open the north-bank sixth works; Guancheng was told to explain again.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「冰窖改口後，水勢暢順。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "After the shift to Bingjiao the current flowed smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: He replied that after the Bingjiao shift the current had run smoothly.

sentences.zh: 上年盛漲，下口十里內淤阻。

translations.literal: Last year during the great rise, silt blocked the lower outlet within ten li.
translations.idiomatic: During last year's peak flood the lower ten li had silted shut.

sentences.zh: 今請於北岸六工放水，循南埝而行，仍以鳳河為尾閭，實於現在情形為便。」

translations.literal: Now I request releasing water at the sixth works on the north bank, running along the southern embankment, still taking the Feng River as the tail outlet—this truly suits present conditions."
translations.idiomatic: He now asked to release water at the north-bank sixth works, run it along the southern embankment, and still use the Feng River as the final outlet—which best fit present conditions.

sentences.zh: 自是永定河下口又改自北岸六工入鳳河。

translations.literal: From then on the lower Yongding outlet was again shifted from the sixth works on the north bank into the Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding's lower outlet was shifted again from the north-bank sixth works into the Feng River.

sentences.zh: 旋請以鳳河東堤及韓家埝隸永定河道，又請於下口北埝外更作遙埝，為勻沙散水之用，並加築鳳河東隄，與遙埝相接。

translations.literal: He soon requested placing the east dike of the Feng River and the Han family embankment under Yongding River administration, building an outer distant embankment beyond the north embankment at the lower outlet to spread sand and disperse water, and raising the east dike of the Feng River to join the distant embankment.
translations.idiomatic: He soon had the Feng River's east dike and the Han family embankment placed under Yongding administration, built an outer distant embankment beyond the lower north bank to spread silt and disperse floodwater, and raised the Feng River's east dike to connect with it.

sentences.zh: 觀承治永定河凡再改下口，相時決機，從之輒利。

translations.literal: In managing the Yongding Guancheng twice shifted the lower outlet; he seized the moment to decide, and whenever his plans were followed they proved advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng twice moved the Yongding's lower outlet; he timed each decision well, and each shift paid off when adopted.

sentences.zh: 河決長垣、東明，命觀承往勘。

translations.literal: When the river breached at Changyuan and Dongming, Guancheng was ordered to go and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: When the river broke at Changyuan and Dongming, Guancheng was sent to inspect.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「二縣以太行堤為衛，其地南高北下。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The two counties rely on the Taihang dike for protection; the land slopes from south high to north low.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that the two counties depended on the Taihang dike for protection and that the terrain sloped from higher south to lower north.

sentences.zh: 河南陽武諸縣水北注，賴此堤捍之。

translations.literal: Waters from Yangwu and other counties in Henan pour northward and depend on this dike to hold them back.
translations.idiomatic: Floodwaters from Yangwu and other Henan counties poured north and depended on this dike to hold them back.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十年後，屢被沖決。

translations.literal: After the sixtieth year of Kangxi it was repeatedly breached.
translations.idiomatic: After the sixtieth year of Kangxi it had been breached repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 請於堤西開新引河，導水入舊引河東注，即以所起土別築新堤。」

translations.literal: I request opening a new diversion west of the dike to lead the water into the old diversion flowing east, and using the excavated earth to build a new dike separately."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to cut a new diversion west of the dike into the old east-flowing channel and use the spoil to build a new dike.

sentences.zh: 命如所議。

translations.literal: He was ordered to proceed as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his plan.

sentences.zh: 觀承疏請治子牙河，自楊家口至閻兒莊，改支河為正河。

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized to manage the Ziya River from Yangjiakou to Yan'erzhuang, making the branch channel the main river.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng proposed works on the Ziya River from Yangjiakou to Yan'erzhuang, promoting the branch channel to the main course.

sentences.zh: 复於閻兒莊北循堤濬新引河接黑港舊引河，俱於子牙橋北入正河。

translations.literal: He also dredged a new diversion north of Yan'erzhuang along the dike to join the old Heigang diversion, both entering the main channel north of the Ziya Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: North of Yan'erzhuang he dredged a new diversion along the dike to link the old Heigang channel, both rejoining the main river north of Ziya Bridge.

sentences.zh: 疏請治滹沱河，自晉州張岔山口改流，南出寧晉入滏陽河，當順新道。

translations.literal: He memorialized to manage the Hutuo River, shifting its course from Zhangcha Pass in Jizhou south through Ningjin into the Fuyang River, following the new channel.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed redirecting the Hutuo from Zhangcha Pass in Jizhou south through Ningjin into the Fuyang River along its new course.

sentences.zh: 疏請治漳河，自臨漳東南改流趨大名，分支：一出城北，一流入河間。

translations.literal: He memorialized to manage the Zhang River, shifting its course southeast from Linzhang toward Daming with branches: one out north of the city wall, one flowing into Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed redirecting the Zhang southeast from Linzhang toward Daming in two branches—one north of the city wall and one into Hejian.

sentences.zh: 當於河口築壩，斷水南流。

translations.literal: A dam should be built at the river mouth to cut off southward flow.
translations.idiomatic: A dam at the mouth would block the southward flow.

sentences.zh: 疏淤濬河，引水歸故道。

translations.literal: He dredged silt and deepened the river to lead the water back to the old course.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged the channel and returned the water to its old course.

sentences.zh: 皆如議行。

translations.literal: All were carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved and carried out.

sentences.zh: 又疏濬易州安國河，開渠灌田，賜名曰安河。

translations.literal: He also dredged the Anguo River in Yizhou, opened canals to irrigate fields, and it was granted the name An River.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged the Anguo River in Yizhou, opened irrigation canals, and the emperor named it the An River.

sentences.zh: 上以河南巡撫胡寶瑔督民間繕治道路溝洫，令觀承仿行。

translations.literal: Because Henan Governor Hu Baozhen supervised the people in repairing roads and ditches, the emperor ordered Guancheng to follow his example.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had Guancheng follow the example of Henan Governor Hu Baozhen, who organized local repair of roads and ditches.

sentences.zh: 觀承方令諸州縣以工代賑，修​​堤埝，濬減河，築疊道，凡三十二州縣。

translations.literal: Guancheng was already ordering the prefectures and counties to use labor in place of relief, repairing dikes and embankments, dredging flood channels, and building raised roads—in thirty-two prefectures and counties altogether.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng was already using work-for-relief across thirty-two prefectures and counties to repair dikes, dredge flood channels, and build raised roads.

sentences.zh: 既奉命，奏言：「正定、順德、廣平、大名等地民力易集，近年漳、漆、滏、洺諸水疏通。

translations.literal: After receiving the order he memorialized: "In Zhengding, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, and other places labor is easy to gather; in recent years the Zhang, Qi, Fu, and Ming rivers have been cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Once ordered to proceed, he reported that in Zhengding, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, and similar districts labor was easy to mobilize and that the Zhang, Qi, Fu, and Ming rivers had recently been cleared.

sentences.zh: 他處亦先後開工。

translations.literal: Other places also began work in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Work had begun elsewhere as well.

sentences.zh: 要使瀝水有歸，農田杜患。」

translations.literal: The aim is to give standing water an outlet and keep farmland free from harm."
translations.idiomatic: The goal was to give runoff somewhere to go and keep fields safe from flooding.

sentences.zh: 逾年，疏報自大興、宛平東至撫寧，西至易、涿，西南至望都，東南至阜城；

translations.literal: A year later he reported from Daxing and Wanping east to Funing, west to Yi and Zhuo, southwest to Wangdu, and southeast to Fucheng;
translations.idiomatic: A year later he reported work from Daxing and Wanping east to Funing, west to Yi and Zhuo, southwest to Wangdu, and southeast to Fucheng;

sentences.zh: 复循運河自武清至吳橋，凡二十二州縣，築疊道，開溝渠，諸工皆竟。

translations.literal: He also followed the Grand Canal from Wuqing to Wuqiao through twenty-two prefectures and counties, building raised roads and opening ditches; all the works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: He extended the work along the Grand Canal from Wuqing to Wuqiao across twenty-two prefectures and counties, building raised roads and digging channels until every project was finished.

sentences.zh: 直隸北境東自熱河，西至宣化，皆接蒙古界，流民出塞耕蒙古地。

translations.literal: Zhili's northern border from Rehe in the east to Xuanhua in the west all adjoins Mongolia; displaced persons crossed the frontier to farm Mongol land.
translations.idiomatic: From Rehe in the east to Xuanhua in the west, Zhili's northern frontier bordered Mongolia, and displaced people crossed the passes to farm on Mongol land.

sentences.zh: 永定河改道冰窖之歲，土默特貝子哈木噶巴牙斯呼郎圖議驅民收地。

translations.literal: In the year the Yongding was shifted to Bingjiao, the Tumed prince Hamagabayas Hulangtu proposed driving out the people and reclaiming the land.
translations.idiomatic: The year the Yongding was redirected to Bingjiao, the Tumed prince Hamagabayas Hulangtu proposed expelling the settlers and reclaiming the land.

sentences.zh: 觀承疏言：「貧民無家可歸，即甘受驅逐，而數万男婦，內地亦難於安置，請簡大臣按治。」

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized: "The poor have no home to return to; even if they would accept expulsion, tens of thousands of men and women could hardly be resettled within the interior. I request dispatching a senior minister to investigate and settle the matter."
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng argued that the poor had nowhere to go; even if they accepted expulsion, tens of thousands of men and women could not easily be resettled inland, and he asked the court to send a senior minister to investigate.

sentences.zh: 上遣侍郎劉綸等往勘，議仍用原定年限，語詳綸傳。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Vice Minister Liu Lun and others to inspect; it was decided to keep the originally fixed term limits—the details are in Lun's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Vice Minister Liu Lun and others to inspect; they upheld the original time limits, as recounted in Lun's biography.

sentences.zh: 是歲，理籓院尚書納延泰議撤多倫諾爾鋪司，毋佔蒙古游牧。

translations.literal: That year Minister Nayantai of the Court of Colonial Affairs proposed abolishing the relay stations at Duolun Nuo'er so they would not encroach on Mongol pasture.
translations.idiomatic: That year Colonial Affairs Minister Nayantai proposed abolishing the Duolun Nuo'er relay stations so they would not encroach on Mongol grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 觀承奏：「多倫諾爾自設鋪司，文移資送郵，解餉得棲止，行旅亦堪投宿，並無礙於游牧​​。

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized: "Since Duolun Nuo'er established relay stations, documents and supplies have been forwarded by post, couriers bearing funds have had lodging, and travelers have had places to stay, without hindering pastoral migration.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng replied that since Duolun Nuo'er had relay stations, official mail and supplies moved smoothly, fund couriers and travelers had lodging, and pastoral migration was not impeded.

sentences.zh: 今於南茶棚、上渡、轉山子、水泉子諸地量留屋宇，如或藏匿匪類，責所司究治。」

translations.literal: Now at Nanchapeng, Shangdu, Zhuanshanzi, Shuiquanzi, and other places buildings should be retained as needed; if bandits are harbored, the responsible officials should be held to account."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed keeping buildings as needed at Nanchapeng, Shangdu, Zhuanshanzi, Shuiquanzi, and similar posts, with local officials held responsible if bandits were harbored."

sentences.zh: 觀承復請熱河編立煙戶，令有司稽察。

translations.literal: Guancheng again requested registering tobacco households in Rehe and ordering local officials to inspect them.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng also asked to register tobacco households in Rehe under official supervision.

sentences.zh: 附近敖漢、柰曼、翁牛特、土默特諸部，副都統歲週巡。

translations.literal: Among the nearby banners of Aohan, Naiman, Wengniute, and Tumed, the vice commandant should make annual rounds.
translations.idiomatic: Among the nearby Aohan, Naiman, Wengniute, and Tumed banners, the vice commandant was to patrol annually.

sentences.zh: 理籓院議商人領票赴恰克圖、庫倫貿易，不得往喀爾喀各旗私與為市，並禁張家口設肆。

translations.literal: The Court of Colonial Affairs proposed that merchants with licenses trade at Kyakhta and Urga but not privately trade with Khalkha banners, and also banned opening shops at Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Colonial Affairs proposed licensed trade at Kyakhta and Urga but forbade private trading with Khalkha banners and banned shops at Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 觀承疏言：「禁張家口設肆，商人赴恰克圖、庫倫者日少。

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized: "Banning shops at Zhangjiakou has daily reduced the merchants going to Kyakhta and Urga.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng argued that banning shops at Zhangjiakou had steadily reduced traffic to Kyakhta and Urga.

sentences.zh: 內地資蒙古馬羊皮革，蒙古亦需內地茶布，有無不能相通，未見其益。

translations.literal: The interior relies on Mongol horses, sheep, and hides; Mongolia also needs interior tea and cloth. If supply and demand cannot connect, no benefit is seen.
translations.idiomatic: The interior needed Mongol horses, sheep, and hides, while Mongolia needed tea and cloth from China; cutting off exchange brought no clear benefit.

sentences.zh: 請令商人領票赴恰克圖、庫倫，仍許經過喀爾喀各旗相為交易，但不得久居放債，礙蒙古生計。」

translations.literal: I request that merchants with licenses go to Kyakhta and Urga and still be allowed to trade with Khalkha banners in passing, but not to stay long or lend on interest, harming Mongol livelihoods."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that licensed merchants go to Kyakhta and Urga and still trade with Khalkha banners along the route, but not stay long or lend at interest in ways that would harm Mongol livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 御史七十五請於多倫諾爾收稅，觀承奏：「內地茶布自張家口往，毋庸重徵。

translations.literal: Censor Qishiwu requested collecting taxes at Duolun Nuo'er; Guancheng memorialized: "Tea and cloth from the interior going out through Zhangjiakou need not be taxed again.
translations.idiomatic: When Censor Qishiwu proposed taxing trade at Duolun Nuo'er, Guancheng replied that tea and cloth leaving through Zhangjiakou should not be taxed twice.

sentences.zh: 惟恰克圖、庫倫等地互市，及克什克騰木植，當於多倫諾爾徵稅。」

translations.literal: Only trade at Kyakhta, Urga, and other places, and timber from Keshiketeng, should be taxed at Duolun Nuo'er."
translations.idiomatic: Taxes at Duolun Nuo'er should apply only to trade at Kyakhta, Urga, and similar markets and to timber from Keshiketeng."

sentences.zh: 右衛兵移駐張家口，觀承疏言：「歲支米粟不敷一萬四千餘石。

translations.literal: When the Youwei garrison was moved to Zhangjiakou, Guancheng memorialized: "Annual grain disbursement falls short by more than fourteen thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Youwei garrison was posted to Zhangjiakou, Guancheng reported an annual shortfall of more than fourteen thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 請以宣化、懷來、懷安、蔚、西寧五州縣徵豆改粟米出糴，至張家口糴米，可得八千餘石。

translations.literal: I request that the five prefectures and counties of Xuanhua, Huailai, Huai'an, Yu, and Xining convert bean levies to millet for sale, and purchase grain at Zhangjiakou to obtain more than eight thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: He asked Xuanhua, Huailai, Huai'an, Yu, and Xining to convert bean levies to millet for sale and buy grain at Zhangjiakou to make up more than eight thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 又以領催、前鋒、馬兵歲米五之一改折加給，俾兵食有資，而轉輸可省。」

translations.literal: Also convert one-fifth of the annual grain for paymasters, vanguard, and cavalry into cash at a premium so the troops have provisions while transport costs are saved."
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed converting one-fifth of the annual grain ration for paymasters, vanguard, and cavalry into cash at a premium so troops were fed while transport costs fell.

sentences.zh: 兵部議以張家口副將隸察哈爾都統，觀承疏請將邊外七汛隸都統，左衛、懷安仍隸宣化鎮。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War proposed placing the Zhangjiakou deputy commander under the Chahar commandant; Guancheng memorialized to place the seven frontier posts outside the passes under the commandant while Zuowei and Huai'an remained under Xuanhua garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War proposed placing the Zhangjiakou deputy commander under the Chahar commandant; Guancheng asked that the seven frontier posts be placed under the commandant while Zuowei and Huai'an stayed under Xuanhua garrison.

sentences.zh: 漕船自清江至通州，天津為南北運河樞鍵。

translations.literal: Grain transport ships sail from Qingjiang to Tongzhou; Tianjin is the pivot of the north-south Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Grain barges ran from Qingjiang to Tongzhou, with Tianjin as the hinge of the north-south canal system.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，漕船遲至，上命觀承督民船起剝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the grain fleet arrived late; the emperor ordered Guancheng to supervise civilian boats in lightering.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the grain fleet arrived late, and the emperor ordered Guancheng to supervise civilian lightering boats.

sentences.zh: 觀承於北倉設席囤貯米，令交兌船泊北倉南，起剝船泊北倉北，皆傍東岸。

translations.literal: Guancheng set up mat sheds at Beicang to store grain, ordering delivery boats to moor south of Beicang and lightering boats north of Beicang, all along the east bank.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng built mat sheds at Beicang to store grain, moored delivery boats south of the depot and lightering boats to the north, all along the east bank.

sentences.zh: 一幫限二里，同時起米不相妨。

translations.literal: Each convoy was limited to two li so simultaneous lightering would not interfere.
translations.idiomatic: Each convoy was limited to two li so boats could lighter grain at the same time without blocking one another.

sentences.zh: 西岸行空船，計日畢事。

translations.literal: Empty boats traveled the west bank, and the work was finished within the allotted days.
translations.idiomatic: Empty boats used the west bank, and the work was finished on schedule.

sentences.zh: 疏請發庫帑給腳價，明歲新漕歸款。

translations.literal: He memorialized to disburse treasury funds for porterage, to be repaid from the new grain transport of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for treasury funds to pay porterage, to be repaid from the next year's grain transport.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，上以北運河水淺，截先到漕艘留米四十萬石貯北倉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, because the northern transport canal was shallow, the emperor detained the first-arriving grain ships and stored four hundred thousand shi at Beicang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, with the northern canal running shallow, the emperor held the first grain ships and stored four hundred thousand shi at Beicang.

sentences.zh: 觀承疏言：「前幫截留，後幫繼進，為日無多。

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized: "The leading convoys are detained while the following convoys advance; the interval is not long.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng noted that leading convoys were held while later ones advanced, and the delay would not last long.

sentences.zh: 請以剝為截，令先到各幫每船剝若干，使得輕便，餘米仍抵通州交兌。

translations.literal: I request using lightering in place of detention: let each boat of the first-arriving convoys lighter a portion so it rides higher, while the remaining grain still reaches Tongzhou for delivery.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed lightering instead of detention: each early boat would unload part of its cargo to ride higher while the rest still reached Tongzhou for delivery.

sentences.zh: 應截五六百船全米，勻為千船半米。

translations.literal: What would detain five or six hundred fully loaded boats should be spread as half loads across a thousand boats.
translations.idiomatic: Instead of holding five or six hundred fully loaded boats, the grain could be spread as half loads across a thousand boats.

sentences.zh: 俟河水漲發，繼進之船，浮送無阻。」

translations.literal: When the river rises, the following boats can float through without obstruction."
translations.idiomatic: When the river rose, the following boats could float through without delay.

sentences.zh: 諭獎其妥協。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his workable compromise.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his practical compromise.

sentences.zh: 上以各省錢貴，用山東布政使李渭議，禁富民積錢，家限五十串。

translations.literal: Because cash was dear in the provinces, the emperor adopted the proposal of Shandong Treasurer Li Wei to forbid the wealthy from hoarding cash, limiting each household to fifty strings.
translations.idiomatic: With cash scarce across the provinces, the emperor adopted Shandong Treasurer Li Wei's plan to cap wealthy households at fifty strings of hoarded cash.

sentences.zh: 觀承奏：「富民積錢，勢不能按戶而察之。

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized: "Wealthy hoarding of cash cannot in practice be inspected household by household.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng replied that wealthy cash hoarding could not realistically be checked household by household.

sentences.zh: 與其限所積不能稽所入，請令交易在三十兩以下者許用錢，過是即用銀，違者收以官價。

translations.literal: Rather than limiting what is hoarded without being able to audit what comes in, I request that transactions under thirty taels may use cash; above that silver must be used, and violators' cash shall be taken at official rates.
translations.idiomatic: Rather than capping hoards that could not be audited, he proposed allowing cash only for transactions under thirty taels, requiring silver above that, and confiscating violators' cash at official rates.

sentences.zh: 富民積錢，諭令易銀，違者以十之二入官。

translations.literal: Wealthy hoarders of cash should be ordered to convert to silver; violators shall forfeit two-tenths to the government.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy hoarders should be ordered to convert cash to silver, with two-tenths forfeited to the state for violations.

sentences.zh: 至尋常出入，應各從其便。」

translations.literal: As for ordinary daily transactions, each should follow convenience."
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary daily transactions should be left to local convenience.

sentences.zh: 上問：「成效若何？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked: "What has been the result?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked what results had been achieved.

sentences.zh: 觀承言：「富戶錢漸出，市值亦平減。」

translations.literal: Guancheng said: "Wealthy households' cash is gradually coming out, and market prices are also easing."
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng reported that wealthy households were releasing cash and market prices were easing.

sentences.zh: 廷議各省糶米，商人往往藉口昂值，下觀承覈議。

translations.literal: Court discussion on selling grain in the provinces noted that merchants often used pretexts to raise prices; the matter was referred to Guancheng for review.
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated provincial grain sales, it found merchants often inflated prices; Guancheng was asked to review the policy.

sentences.zh: 觀承疏：「請需米省分具款交產米省分，令有司代購。

translations.literal: Guancheng memorialized: "I request that provinces needing grain supply funds to grain-producing provinces and have local officials purchase on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng proposed that grain-deficit provinces send funds to surplus provinces and have local officials purchase grain on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 則牙儈不敢抗地方官教令，操縱自如。」

translations.literal: Then brokers would not dare defy local officials' orders and manipulate prices at will."
translations.idiomatic: Brokers would then not dare defy local officials or manipulate prices freely.

sentences.zh: 疏並下部議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent to the ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent to the ministries for implementation.

sentences.zh: 觀承督陝、甘，董理儲糈，送駝馬，運糧茶，上敕以妥速為要。

translations.literal: Guancheng supervised Shaanxi and Gansu, overseeing stored provisions, dispatching camels and horses, and transporting grain and tea; the emperor ordered that safety and speed were essential.
translations.idiomatic: As supervisor of Shaanxi and Gansu, Guancheng managed stored provisions, dispatched camels and horses, and moved grain and tea; the emperor stressed both reliability and speed.

sentences.zh: 方冬，疏言哈密至巴里坤大坂積雪，遣兵剷除，請日加面四兩。

translations.literal: In mid-winter he memorialized that snow blocked the pass from Hami to Barkul; he sent troops to clear it and requested an extra four liang of flour per day.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he reported snow blocking the Hami–Barkul pass, sent troops to clear it, and asked for an extra four liang of flour per man per day.

sentences.zh: 在陝、甘四閱月，即返直隸。

translations.literal: After four months in Shaanxi and Gansu he returned to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: After four months in Shaanxi and Gansu he returned to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 觀承蒞政精密，畿輔事繁重，乘輿歲臨幸，往來供張。

translations.literal: Guancheng governed with meticulous care; affairs in the capital region were heavy, and each year the imperial progress required supplies along the route.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng governed with meticulous care; the capital region's duties were heavy, and each year the emperor's tours required elaborate provisioning along the route.

sentences.zh: 值西征師行，具營幕芻糧，未嘗少乏，軍興而於民無擾。

translations.literal: When the western campaign marched, he furnished camps, fodder, and grain without shortage; though the army mobilized, the people were not disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: During the western campaign he supplied camps, fodder, and grain without shortfall, mobilizing the army without burdening the people.

sentences.zh: 尤勤於民事，嘗請以永定河淤灘，堤內外留十丈，備栽柳取土，餘畀守堤貧民領耕輸租。

translations.literal: He was especially diligent in civil affairs, once requesting that silt flats on the Yongding reserve ten zhang inside and outside the dike for planting willows and taking earth, with the remainder given to poor dike guards to farm and pay rent.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially attentive to local welfare, once proposing that Yongding silt flats reserve ten zhang on each side of the dike for willows and earthworks while poor dike guards farmed the rest and paid rent.

sentences.zh: 又請以永定河葦地改藝秋禾，又以麥田牧羊，奏請申禁。

translations.literal: He also requested converting reed lands on the Yongding to autumn grain and memorialized to forbid grazing sheep in wheat fields.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed converting Yongding reed beds to autumn grain and memorialized to forbid grazing sheep in wheat fields.

sentences.zh: 又舉木棉事十六則，為圖說以進，上為題詩。

translations.literal: He also presented sixteen items on cotton cultivation with illustrated explanations; the emperor composed a poem for them.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted sixteen points on cotton cultivation with illustrated explanations, and the emperor wrote a poem in response.

sentences.zh: 溝渠疊道工竟，又請將欒城、柏鄉、內丘、定興、安肅、望都諸縣改築磚城。

translations.literal: When ditch and raised-road works were finished, he again requested rebuilding brick city walls in Luanzhou, Baixiang, Neiqiu, Dingxing, Ansu, and Wangdu.
translations.idiomatic: After the ditch and raised-road works were done, he asked to rebuild brick city walls in Luanzhou, Baixiang, Neiqiu, Dingxing, Ansu, and Wangdu.

sentences.zh: 涿州拒馬河橋圮，令改建石橋。

translations.literal: The Juma River bridge at Zhuozhou collapsed; he was ordered to rebuild it in stone.
translations.idiomatic: When the Juma River bridge at Zhuozhou collapsed, he was ordered to rebuild it in stone.

sentences.zh: 又重建衡水縣西橋，請賜名安濟。

translations.literal: He also rebuilt the west bridge in Hengshui County and requested the name Anji be granted.
translations.idiomatic: He also rebuilt Hengshui's west bridge and asked that it be named Anji.

sentences.zh: 政無鉅細，皆殫心力赴之。

translations.literal: In administration, great or small, he devoted his full energy.
translations.idiomatic: In matters great and small he gave his full energy.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，上命勘天津等處積水，責觀承玩誤，下部議奪官，命寬之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the emperor ordered inspection of standing water at Tianjin and elsewhere, blamed Guancheng for negligence, referred him to the ministries for dismissal, and then ordered leniency.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year the emperor ordered an inspection of flooding at Tianjin and elsewhere, blamed Guancheng for negligence, referred him for dismissal, then showed leniency.

sentences.zh: 御史吉夢熊、硃續經交章劾觀承，上諭曰：「觀承在直久，存息事寧人之見。

translations.literal: Censors Ji Mengxiong and Zhu Xujing memorialized together to impeach Guancheng; the emperor instructed: "Guancheng has long been in Zhili and holds a view of calming affairs and pacifying people.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Ji Mengxiong and Zhu Xujing impeached Guancheng together; the emperor said Guancheng had long served in Zhili with a habit of smoothing matters to keep the peace.

sentences.zh: 前以天津等處積水未消，予以懲儆，而言者動以為歸過之地。

translations.literal: Earlier, because standing water at Tianjin and elsewhere had not subsided, he was punished as a warning, yet critics constantly treat this as a place to assign blame.
translations.idiomatic: He had been punished earlier when Tianjin's floodwater had not receded, yet critics kept treating that as a pretext to blame him.

sentences.zh: 直隸事務殷繁，又值災歉，措置不無竭蹶。

translations.literal: Zhili's affairs are numerous, and disasters and poor harvests have occurred; in coping there has been no lack of strain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's duties were heavy, and disasters and poor harvests had strained his resources.

sentences.zh: 言易行難，持論者易地以處，恐未必能如觀承之勉力支持也。」

translations.literal: It is easy to speak and hard to act; those who hold opinions, placed in his position, might not support affairs as strenuously as Guancheng has."
translations.idiomatic: Talk is easy and action hard; critics in his place might not have supported the province as tirelessly as Guancheng had.

sentences.zh: 三十年，上南巡，賜詩。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, on the southern tour, the emperor granted him a poem.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, during the southern tour, the emperor gave him a poem.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，病瘧，遣醫診視。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he fell ill with malaria; physicians were sent to treat him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he fell ill with malaria and physicians were sent to treat him.

sentences.zh: 八月，卒，賜祭葬，諡恪敏。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he died; imperial sacrifices and burial were granted, and the posthumous name Kemin was given.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth month; the court granted funeral rites and the posthumous name Kemin.

sentences.zh: 御製懷舊詩，入五督臣中。

translations.literal: The emperor composed a poem in remembrance of him, ranking him among the five great governors.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote a memorial poem placing him among the five great governors.

sentences.zh: 子維甸，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Weidian has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Weidian has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 富明安，富察氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Ming'an, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ming'an of the Fuca clan was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 初授筆帖式。

translations.literal: He was first appointed a clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a clerk.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted in stages to director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，授廣東惠潮嘉道，歷廣東高廉、糧驛，廣西蒼梧諸道，福建、廣西按察使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Qianlong he was appointed Huichaojia Circuit intendant of Guangdong, then served as Gaolian and Grain-Transport intendant of Guangdong, Cangwu intendant of Guangxi, and provincial surveillance commissioner of Fujian and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Qianlong he became Huichaojia Circuit intendant in Guangdong, later served as Gaolian and grain-transport intendant in Guangdong, Cangwu intendant in Guangxi, and provincial surveillance commissioner in Fujian and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，遷江西布政使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred to provincial treasurer of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he became provincial treasurer of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 請以南昌同知、通判二員定一員為滿缺，專司繙譯清文。

translations.literal: He requested that one of the two posts of Nanchang sub-prefect and prefectural judge be fixed as a Manchu quota post devoted to translating Manchu documents.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that one of Nanchang's sub-prefect and prefectural judge posts be reserved for a Manchu official to handle Manchu document translation.

sentences.zh: 上以江西無駐防滿洲兵，不允。

translations.literal: The emperor, noting that Jiangxi had no garrisoned Manchu troops, did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused, noting that Jiangxi had no garrisoned Manchu troops.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，命往巴里坤辦事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was ordered to Barkul on official business.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was sent to Barkul on official business.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，廣東巡撫明山劾富明安官糧驛道浮收倉米，奪官，逮京師鞫治。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Guangdong Governor Mingshan impeached Fu Ming'an, grain-transport intendant, for over-collecting granary rice; he was dismissed and taken to the capital for trial.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year Guangdong Governor Mingshan accused grain-transport intendant Fu Ming'an of over-collecting granary rice; he was dismissed and brought to the capital for trial.

sentences.zh: 事白，复官，命署山西布政使。

translations.literal: When the matter was cleared he was restored to office and ordered to serve as acting provincial treasurer of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When cleared he was restored and appointed acting provincial treasurer of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，護巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he acted as governor.

sentences.zh: 劾雁平道時廷靄縱僕擾民，坐奪官。

translations.literal: He impeached Yanping Circuit intendant Shi Ting'ai for allowing servants to harass the people and was himself dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Yanping Circuit intendant Shi Ting'ai for allowing servants to harass the people, but lost his own post in the affair.

sentences.zh: 擢山東巡撫。

translations.literal: He was promoted to governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「高密百脈湖受五龍河、膠河諸水，夏秋常苦泛溢。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Gaomi's Baimai Lake receives the Wulong River, Jiao River, and other waters; in summer and autumn it often suffers flooding.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Gaomi's Baimai Lake received the Wulong, Jiao, and other rivers and flooded every summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 請濬引河，引膠河北入膠、萊運河，涸出新地得四百餘頃。」

translations.literal: I request dredging a diversion to lead the Jiao River north into the Jiao-Lai Canal; when the lake dries, more than four hundred qing of new land will be gained."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to dredge a diversion sending the Jiao north into the Jiao-Lai Canal, reclaiming more than four hundred qing when the lake drained.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended the plan.

sentences.zh: 太僕寺少卿範宜賓奏請裁減東省閉壩後驛夫工食，富明安疏言：「水驛夫役終歲在驛，閉壩多在十一月，開壩有早至正月者，中間相距兩月餘，而銅、鉛諸船守凍，尚須守護。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Fan Yibin of the Court of the Imperial Stud memorialized to cut post-station workers' rations after the sluice gates closed in the eastern provinces; Fu Ming'an memorialized: "Water-post laborers serve at the station year-round; gates usually close in the eleventh month and may reopen as early as the first, a gap of more than two months, while copper and lead boats wintering on the river still need guarding.
translations.idiomatic: Court of the Imperial Stud Vice Minister Fan Yibin proposed cutting post workers' rations after the eastern sluice gates closed; Fu Ming'an replied that water-post laborers served year-round, gates often stayed closed from the eleventh month until the first, and copper and lead boats still needed guarding through the freeze.

sentences.zh: 節省無多，窒礙轉甚，非政體所宜。」

translations.literal: The savings would be slight while the obstruction would be severe; this is not fitting policy."
translations.idiomatic: Savings would be small while the disruption would be great—not sound policy.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: His view was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，疏言：「小清河行章丘、鄒平、長山、新城、高苑、博興、樂安​​七縣六百餘裡。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he memorialized: "The Xiaoqing River runs more than six hundred li through seven counties—Zhangqiu, Zouping, Changshan, Xincheng, Gaoyuan, Boxing, and Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year he reported that the Xiaoqing River ran more than six hundred li through Zhangqiu, Zouping, Changshan, Xincheng, Gaoyuan, Boxing, and Le'an.

sentences.zh: 源出章丘，東至新城、高苑間分支，北為支脈溝；

translations.literal: It rises in Zhangqiu; eastward between Xincheng and Gaoyuan it branches, with the northern branch as the Zhimai Ditch;
translations.idiomatic: It rose in Zhangqiu; east of Xincheng and Gaoyuan it split, with the northern branch forming the Zhimai Ditch;

sentences.zh: 又東至博興分支，南為豫備河。

translations.literal: farther east at Boxing it branches again, with the southern branch as the Yubei River.
translations.idiomatic: and farther east at Boxing it split again, with the southern branch as the Yubei River.

sentences.zh: 至樂安入淄水歸海。

translations.literal: At Le'an it enters the Zi River and reaches the sea.
translations.idiomatic: At Le'an it entered the Zi River and reached the sea.

sentences.zh: 比年湖泊淤塞，春夏水漲，民田常被其害。

translations.literal: In recent years the lakes have silted up; when water rises in spring and summer, farmland is often harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years silting had raised flood levels in spring and summer and damaged farmland.

sentences.zh: 現就樂安境內挑淤培堤，並疏濬南、北支渠，使支干通流，建瓴而下。

translations.literal: Now within Le'an we are dredging silt and raising dikes and clearing the southern and northern branch channels so branches and trunk flow freely and water descends like from a rooftop eave.
translations.idiomatic: Within Le'an he was dredging silt, raising dikes, and clearing north and south branch channels so water could run freely from trunk to branches.

sentences.zh: 博興、樂安​​可復膏腴。

translations.literal: Boxing and Le'an can again become fertile.
translations.idiomatic: Boxing and Le'an could become fertile again.

sentences.zh: 章丘、鄒平、長山、新城、高苑諸縣附近湖泊涸出，有益於民。

translations.literal: Lakes near Zhangqiu, Zouping, Changshan, Xincheng, and Gaoyuan will dry out, benefiting the people.
translations.idiomatic: Drying lakes near Zhangqiu, Zouping, Changshan, Xincheng, and Gaoyuan would benefit local farmers.

sentences.zh: 民咸原出力興工，毋庸動帑。」

translations.literal: The people are all willing to contribute labor; there is no need to use treasury funds."
translations.idiomatic: Local people were willing to supply labor, so no treasury funds were needed.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「有利於民，事在應為，但不可滋弊耳。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "What benefits the people should be done, but abuses must not be allowed to grow."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that what helped the people should be done, but abuses must not be allowed."

sentences.zh: 三十六年，又奏：「濟寧西北當運河西岸，受上游曹州境內諸水。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he again memorialized: "Northwest of Jining on the west bank of the Grand Canal, it receives various waters from upstream in Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he reported that northwest of Jining, on the canal's west bank, the area received floodwaters from upstream Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 以運河勢高，不能洩水入運，遂至間段停積。

translations.literal: Because the canal bed is high, water cannot drain into the canal and pools in sections.
translations.idiomatic: Because the canal ran higher than the surrounding land, water could not drain into it and pooled in stretches.

sentences.zh: 飭濬舊有五渠，使南匯昭陽湖，並同時修治沂水、涑水、墨河、響水諸渠二十餘處，及運河東岸徒駭、馬頰諸河，洩漲水入海。」

translations.literal: He ordered dredging the five old channels so water flows south into Zhaoyang Lake, and at the same time repairing more than twenty channels including the Yi, Su, Mo, and Xiang rivers, and on the canal's east bank the Tuhai, Mabang, and other rivers to discharge floodwater to the sea."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the five old channels dredged to send water south into Zhaoyang Lake, repaired more than twenty channels including the Yi, Su, Mo, and Xiang, and cleared eastern rivers such as the Tuhai and Mabang to discharge floodwater to the sea.

sentences.zh: 上以「知勤民之本」嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended him with the words "knowing the root of diligent care for the people."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him, saying he understood "the root of diligent care for the people."

sentences.zh: 三十八年，授閩浙總督，調湖廣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was appointed governor-general of Fujian-Zhejiang and transferred to Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year he was made governor-general of Fujian-Zhejiang and then transferred to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，京山民嚴金龍父子為亂，捕得置諸法。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year Yan Jinlong, a commoner of Jingshan, and his son raised a rebellion; when captured they were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year Yan Jinlong, a man of Jingshan, and his son rebelled; once captured, both were punished under the law.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子太保，諡恭恪。

translations.literal: He died; was posthumously given Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Gongke.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Gongke.

sentences.zh: 周元理，字秉中，浙江仁和人。

translations.literal: Zhou Yuanli, styled Bingzhong, was a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Yuanli, whose style was Bingzhong, came from Renhe in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年舉人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in the third year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以知縣揀發直隸，補蠡縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, selected as a magistrate for assignment to Zhili, he was appointed to Li County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was selected as a magistrate for Zhili and appointed to Li County.

sentences.zh: 調清苑。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 以總督方觀承薦，擢廣東萬州知州，改霸州。

translations.literal: On Governor-General Fang Guancheng's recommendation, he was promoted to magistrate of Wanzhou in Guangdong, then reassigned to Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended by Governor-General Fang Guancheng, he was promoted to magistrate of Wanzhou in Guangdong and then reassigned to Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 以修城未竣，留清苑。

translations.literal: Because the city-wall repairs were unfinished, he remained at Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Because the city-wall repairs were not yet finished, he stayed on at Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 會有部胥持偽劄馳傳者，察其奸，詰問具服，事上聞，上才之。

translations.literal: It happened that a ministry clerk was using a forged dispatch to travel by courier relay; he detected the fraud, questioned him until he confessed fully, reported it upward, and the emperor recognized his talent.
translations.idiomatic: When a ministry clerk was caught using a forged dispatch to travel by relay courier, he exposed the fraud, interrogated him until he confessed, reported the case upward, and the emperor marked him as a man of talent.

sentences.zh: 調易州，擢宣化知府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Yizhou and promoted to prefect of Xuanhua.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yizhou and promoted to prefect of Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸。

translations.literal: On his mother's death he returned home to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 上屢出巡幸，畿輔當其衝，宮館、驛傳、車馬、芻牧諸役，主辦非其人，往往為民厲，奏起元理董其事。

translations.literal: The emperor often went on tour; the capital region lay in his path, and for palace lodging, relay stations, carriages and horses, and fodder duties, if the person in charge was not right, it often harmed the people—a memorial was submitted to recall Yuanli to oversee these matters.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor often toured and the capital region lay directly in his path, palace lodging, relay stations, transport, and fodder duties frequently burdened the people when the wrong men were put in charge; a memorial was submitted to recall Yuanli to supervise them.

sentences.zh: 服闋，補廣平，調天津，又調保定。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was appointed to Guangping, transferred to Tianjin, and then to Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he was appointed to Guangping, then transferred to Tianjin and afterward to Baoding.

sentences.zh: 擢清河道，遷按察使，再遷布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Qinghe Circuit intendant, transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner, and again to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Qinghe Circuit intendant, then made provincial surveillance commissioner, and later provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，命從尚書裘曰修、總督楊廷璋勘青縣、滄州減河。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was ordered to join Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Governor-General Yang Tingzhang in surveying the flood channels at Qing County and Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was ordered to join Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Governor-General Yang Tingzhang in inspecting flood channels at Qing County and Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 用元理議，請撤閘改用滾水壩，並定每歲測量疏濬，從之。

translations.literal: Yuanli's proposal was adopted: remove the sluice gates and use overflow dams instead, and fix annual surveys and dredging—the court agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted Yuanli's plan to remove the sluice gates and use overflow dams instead, with annual surveys and dredging fixed by rule.

sentences.zh: 旋授山東巡撫。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 奏：「小清河發源章丘長白山，至樂安溜河門入海。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Xiaoqing River rises at Changbai Mountain in Zhangqiu and enters the sea at Liuhe Gate in Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that the Xiaoqing River rose at Changbai Mountain in Zhangqiu and reached the sea at Liuhe Gate in Le'an.

sentences.zh: 章丘至博興，有滸山、清河諸泊為納水之區。

translations.literal: From Zhangqiu to Boxing, lakes such as Hushan and Qinghe serve as areas to receive water.
translations.idiomatic: Between Zhangqiu and Boxing, lakes such as Hushan and Qinghe served as basins to receive floodwater.

sentences.zh: 請先將二泊濬深開廣，遇水發時，有所停蓄，然後聽其入河分注歸海。

translations.literal: I request first dredging and widening the two lakes so that when floods rise there will be storage, and only then allowing water to enter the river and be divided to flow to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the two lakes first be dredged and widened so floodwater could be stored there before being allowed into the river and divided toward the sea.

sentences.zh: 並於每年農隙，疏濬下游各河。」

translations.literal: And each year during the farming slack season, dredge the downstream rivers."
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed dredging the downstream rivers each year during the farming slack season.

sentences.zh: 未半載，擢直隸總督。

translations.literal: Within half a year he was promoted to governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Less than half a year later he was made governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，疏言：「直隸雨多河漲，行潦無歸，行旅多滯。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he memorialized: "Zhili has much rain and swollen rivers; runoff has nowhere to go and travelers are often held up.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he reported that heavy rains in Zhili had swollen the rivers, left runoff with nowhere to go, and often stranded travelers.

sentences.zh: 民間堤埝衝決，田廬受患。

translations.literal: Folk dikes and embankments are breached and fields and dwellings suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Private dikes and embankments were breached, and fields and homes suffered.

sentences.zh: 請用以工作賑例，勘修衝途諸州縣疊道，並濬良鄉茨尾雅河，新城、雄縣盧僧河；

translations.literal: I request applying the work-for-relief precedent to survey and repair raised roads in prefectures and counties along major routes, and dredge the Ciwaiya River in Liangxiang and the Luseng River in Xincheng and Xiong County;
translations.idiomatic: He asked to apply the work-for-relief precedent to survey and repair raised roads in prefectures and counties along major routes, and to dredge the Ciwaiya River in Liangxiang and the Luseng River in Xincheng and Xiong County;

sentences.zh: 修新城、清河、雄、任丘、獻諸縣堤埝。」

translations.literal: and repair dikes and embankments in Xincheng, Qinghe, Xiong, Renqiu, and Xian counties."
translations.idiomatic: and to repair dikes and embankments in Xincheng, Qinghe, Xiong, Renqiu, and Xian counties.

sentences.zh: 上遣尚書裘曰修按行直隸河工，元理與合疏言：「直隸諸水，千支萬派。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Minister Qiu Yuexiu to inspect Zhili river works; Yuanli jointly memorialized, saying: "The waters of Zhili divide into a thousand branches and ten thousand streams.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Minister Qiu Yuexiu to inspect Zhili river works, and Yuanli jointly reported that the waters of Zhili divided into countless branches and streams.

sentences.zh: 總由三汊河為入海之道，全資西岸疊道，置橋穿運，而東匯入海河。

translations.literal: All ultimately take the Sanhe River as the route to the sea, relying entirely on raised roads on the west bank, with bridges built to cross the canal, and on the east merging into the Haihe River.
translations.idiomatic: They all ultimately reached the sea through the Sanhe River, relying on raised roads along the west bank with bridges crossing the canal, and on the east merging into the Haihe.

sentences.zh: 出口西岸舊​​有橋十一，今擬添建橋九，俾無壅遏，上游不至受害。

translations.literal: On the west bank at the outlet there were originally eleven bridges; now nine more are proposed so there will be no obstruction and upstream areas will not suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven bridges already stood on the west bank at the outlet; they proposed adding nine more so water would not be blocked and upstream areas would not suffer.

sentences.zh: 格淀堤自當城以下改為疊道，酌添涵洞，使行水暢順。

translations.literal: The Gedian dike from Dangcheng downward should be converted to a raised road, with culverts added as appropriate, so water flows smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: The Gedian dike from Dangcheng downstream should be converted to a raised road, with culverts added as needed so water could flow freely.

sentences.zh: 子牙河下游澄清，不使清河受淤。」

translations.literal: The lower Ziya River should be cleared so the Qing River does not receive silt."
translations.idiomatic: The lower Ziya River should be cleared so the Qing River would not be silted up.

sentences.zh: 詔如所請。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 雄縣民訴知縣胡錫瑛私鬻倉穀，上遣曰修及侍郎英廉按治得實，論罪。

translations.literal: Commoners of Xiong County accused Magistrate Hu Xiying of privately selling granary grain; the emperor sent Qiu Yuexiu and Vice Minister Ying Lian to investigate; the charge was substantiated and he was punished.
translations.idiomatic: When commoners of Xiong County accused Magistrate Hu Xiying of privately selling granary grain, the emperor sent Qiu Yuexiu and Vice Minister Ying Lian to investigate; the charge was proved and Hu was punished.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「直隸治賑，周元理奏言有司料理妥實。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "In Zhili relief administration, Zhou Yuanli memorialized that officials had handled matters properly and thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "In Zhili relief work, Zhou Yuanli reported that officials had handled matters properly and thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 今有雄縣事，所稱妥實者安在？」

translations.literal: Now with the Xiong County affair, where is this so-called thorough handling?"
translations.idiomatic: Now there is the Xiong County affair—where is this so-called thorough handling?

sentences.zh: 下吏議，奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to officials for deliberation; his rank was stripped, but he was ordered to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: After officials reviewed the case, his rank was stripped, but he was kept in his post.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year he received the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 三十九年八月，山東壽張民王倫為亂，破壽張、堂邑、陽穀，犯東昌及臨清，奪糧艘為浮橋，欲渡運河。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirty-ninth year, Wang Lun, a commoner of Shouzhang in Shandong, raised a rebellion, capturing Shouzhang, Tangyi, and Yanggu, threatening Dongchang and Linqing, seizing grain boats to make a pontoon bridge, and intending to cross the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirty-ninth year Wang Lun, a man of Shouzhang in Shandong, rebelled, seized Shouzhang, Tangyi, and Yanggu, threatened Dongchang and Linqing, took grain boats to build a pontoon bridge, and tried to cross the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 上以畿南地相接，敕守要害。

translations.literal: Because the lands south of the capital adjoined the area, the emperor ordered key points guarded.
translations.idiomatic: Because the region south of the capital bordered the rebel area, the emperor ordered the key passes defended.

sentences.zh: 元理馳至故城，令布政使楊景素、總兵萬朝興、副將瑪爾清阿以兵千二百駐臨清西岸遏其衝。

translations.literal: Yuanli rode hastily to Gucheng and ordered Provincial Treasurer Yang Jingsu, regional commander Wan Chaoxing, and brigade-general Ma'erqing'a to station twelve hundred troops on the west bank of Linqing to block the rebels' thrust.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanli rode hastily to Gucheng and ordered Provincial Treasurer Yang Jingsu, regional commander Wan Chaoxing, and brigade-general Ma'erqing'a to station twelve hundred troops on the west bank of Linqing to block the rebels.

sentences.zh: 大學士舒赫德率禁旅討賊，賊渡西岸犯我師，瑪爾清阿擊敗之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Shuhede led the imperial guard to suppress the rebels; when they crossed to the west bank and attacked our forces, Ma'erqing'a defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Shuhede led the imperial guard against the rebels; when they crossed to the west bank and attacked government forces, Ma'erqing'a defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊潰復合，又為我師所敗，進奪浮橋。

translations.literal: The rebels scattered and regrouped, were again defeated by our forces, and our troops advanced to seize the pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels scattered and regrouped, were defeated again, and government troops advanced to seize the pontoon bridge.

sentences.zh: 賊退保臨清舊城，元理令朝興督兵助攻，倫自焚死，亂旋定。

translations.literal: The rebels retreated to hold the old city of Linqing; Yuanli ordered Chaoxing to supervise the troops in a joint assault; Lun burned himself to death, and the disorder was soon settled.
