translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back to the old city of Linqing; Yuanli ordered Chaoxing to lead a joint assault; Lun burned himself to death, and the rebellion was soon put down.

sentences.zh: 尋與侍郎兼順天府尹蔣賜棨勘八旗在官荒地，請招佃承墾，八年後起租；

translations.literal: Soon afterward, together with Vice Minister and concurrently Shuntian prefect Jiang Ciji, he surveyed idle official land of the Eight Banners and requested recruiting tenants to reclaim it, with rent levied after eight years;
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, together with Vice Minister and concurrently Shuntian prefect Jiang Ciji, he surveyed idle banner land held by the state and proposed recruiting tenants to reclaim it, with rent to begin after eight years;

sentences.zh: 沮洳庳下之區，並為開溝洩水；

translations.literal: in low-lying marshy areas, ditches should also be opened to drain water;
translations.idiomatic: in low-lying marshy areas, ditches should also be opened to drain the water;

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The proposal was sent to the ministries for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was sent to the ministries for implementation.

sentences.zh: 四十年，元理年七十，召至京，御書榜賜之。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, when Yuanli was seventy, he was summoned to the capital and given an imperially inscribed placard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year, when Yuanli turned seventy, he was summoned to the capital and given a placard inscribed by the emperor's own hand.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，與學政羅源漢請熱河增建學校。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, together with provincial education commissioner Luo Yuanhan, he requested adding schools in Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year he and provincial education commissioner Luo Yuanhan asked to establish more schools in Rehe.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，上命改熱河為承德府，令元理壽畫。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year the emperor ordered Rehe changed to Chengde Prefecture and had Yuanli draw up the plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year the emperor ordered Rehe converted into Chengde Prefecture and had Yuanli draft the arrangements.

sentences.zh: 疏請改設州一縣五，增置官吏如製。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting one prefecture and five counties be established, with officials added according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to establish one prefecture and five counties and add officials according to the usual regulations.

sentences.zh: 並請開附近潘家口汛煤窯。

translations.literal: He also requested opening coal mines near the Panjiakou garrison post.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to open coal mines near the Panjiakou garrison post.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，坐井陘知縣週尚親勒派累民，民上訴，元理請罪民。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, because Jingxing Magistrate Zhou Shangqin had extorted levies burdening the people, and the people appealed upward, Yuanli requested punishing the commoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, when Jingxing Magistrate Zhou Shangqin had extorted levies that burdened the people and the people appealed upward, Yuanli asked that the commoners be punished.

sentences.zh: 上命尚書福隆安按治，責元理袒護，奪官，予三品銜，令修正定隆興寺自贖。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Minister Fulung'an to investigate, rebuked Yuanli for favoritism, stripped his office, gave him third-rank status, and ordered him to redeem himself by repairing Longxing Temple in Zhengding.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Minister Fulung'an to investigate, rebuked Yuanli for favoritism, stripped his office, gave him third-rank status, and ordered him to redeem himself by repairing Longxing Temple in Zhengding.

sentences.zh: 尋授左副都御史，仍署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed left vice censor-in-chief and continued to serve as acting governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed left vice censor-in-chief while continuing to serve as acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，遷兵部左侍郎，擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was transferred to left vice minister of War and promoted to minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he was transferred to left vice minister of War and promoted to minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，引疾歸。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he cited illness and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year he cited illness and retired.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the forty-seventh year.

sentences.zh: 令江蘇布政使致祭。

translations.literal: The Jiangsu provincial treasurer was ordered to perform sacrificial rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangsu provincial treasurer was ordered to perform the sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 元理為治舉大體，汎愛兼容。

translations.literal: Yuanli in governance focused on the larger pattern and was broadly tolerant and accommodating.
translations.idiomatic: In governing, Yuanli kept to the larger pattern and was broadly tolerant and accommodating.

sentences.zh: 時以有長者行重之，為方觀承所識拔。

translations.literal: At the time he was esteemed for the conduct of an elder gentleman and was discovered and promoted by Fang Guancheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was respected at the time for the bearing of an elder gentleman and was discovered and promoted by Fang Guancheng.

sentences.zh: 時同入薦剡者曰李湖，亦有名。

translations.literal: One who entered the recommendation rolls with him at the time was Li Hu, who was also well known.
translations.idiomatic: One man recommended with him at the time was Li Hu, who was also well known.

sentences.zh: 李湖，字又川，江西南昌人。

translations.literal: Li Hu, styled Youchuan, was a native of Nanchang in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hu, whose style was Youchuan, came from Nanchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年進士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the fourth year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 初授山東武城知縣，調郯城。

translations.literal: He was first appointed magistrate of Wucheng in Shandong and transferred to Tancheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed magistrate of Wucheng in Shandong and then transferred to Tancheng.

sentences.zh: 累遷直隸通永道，調清河道。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to Tongyong Circuit in Zhili and transferred to Qinghe Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through Tongyong Circuit in Zhili and was transferred to Qinghe Circuit.

sentences.zh: 遷直隸按察使，再遷江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Zhili provincial surveillance commissioner and again to Jiangsu provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He became Zhili provincial surveillance commissioner and later Jiangsu provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，擢貴州巡撫，三十七年，調雲南。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was promoted to governor of Guizhou; in the thirty-seventh year he was transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was made governor of Guizhou, and in the thirty-seventh year he was transferred to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 四十年，總督彰寶以貪婪得罪，責湖隱忍緘默不先劾奏，奪官，予布政使銜，往四川軍營會辦軍需奏銷。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Governor-General Zhang Bao was convicted of greed; Li Hu was rebuked for bearing it in silence and failing to impeach him first; his office was stripped, he was given provincial treasurer status, and sent to the Sichuan army camps to handle military supplies and account settlement jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year Governor-General Zhang Bao was convicted of greed; Li Hu was rebuked for tolerating it in silence and failing to impeach him first, stripped of office, given provincial treasurer rank, and sent to the Sichuan army camps to handle military supplies and accounts.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，授湖南巡撫，四十五年，調廣東。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he was appointed governor of Hunan; in the forty-fifth year he was transferred to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year he was appointed governor of Hunan, and in the forty-fifth year he was transferred to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 湖敏於當官，在貴州規畫鉛運，在雲南釐剔銅政，均如議行。

translations.literal: Li Hu was quick in office; in Guizhou he planned lead transport, and in Yunnan he reformed copper administration—both were carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hu was quick in office: in Guizhou he planned lead transport, and in Yunnan he reformed copper administration, and both plans were carried out.

sentences.zh: 所至以清嚴為政。

translations.literal: Wherever he served, he governed with integrity and strictness.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he served, he governed with integrity and strictness.

sentences.zh: 其蒞廣東，以廣東夙多盜，番禺沙灣、茭塘近海為盜藪，密詗姓名、居址及出入徑途，知群盜以七月望歸設祀，飭文武吏圍捕。

translations.literal: When he arrived in Guangdong, because Guangdong had long had many bandits and Panyu Shawan and Jiaotang near the sea were bandit dens, he secretly inquired into names, residences, and routes in and out; learning that the bandit bands returned on the fifteenth of the seventh month to set up a shrine for worship, he ordered civil and military officials to surround and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: When he took up office in Guangdong, where banditry had long been rife, he learned that Panyu Shawan and Jiaotang near the sea were bandit haunts; he secretly traced names, homes, and routes, discovered that the bands gathered on the fifteenth of the seventh month for a ritual meeting, and ordered civil and military officials to surround and capture them.

sentences.zh: 旬日間誅為首者二百有奇，而釋其脅從，盜風以息。

translations.literal: Within ten days more than two hundred ringleaders were executed, while those coerced to follow were released, and banditry quieted.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days more than two hundred ringleaders were executed, those coerced into following were released, and banditry subsided.

sentences.zh: 旋條奏申明員弁，責成編船移汛，設施甚備，令行法立，民咸頌之。

translations.literal: He soon submitted detailed memorials clarifying duties for officers, holding them responsible for organizing boats and shifting garrison posts; the arrangements were thorough, orders were enforced and law established, and the people all praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted detailed memorials clarifying officers' duties, holding them responsible for organizing boats and shifting garrison posts; the arrangements were thorough, orders took effect, and the people praised him.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈尚書銜，諡恭毅，祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: He died; was posthumously given ministerial rank, the posthumous name Gongyi, and enshrined in the Hall of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously given ministerial rank, the posthumous name Gongyi, and a place in the Hall of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 李瀚，字文瀾，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Li Han, styled Wenlan, was a Han Chinese bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han, whose style was Wenlan, was a Han Chinese bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 少孤，母苦節食貧，撫以成立。

translations.literal: Orphaned young, his mother endured hardship and poverty in virtue and raised him to maturity.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, he was raised to maturity by a mother who endured poverty while keeping her virtue.

sentences.zh: 瀚選入咸安宮肄業。

translations.literal: Han was selected to study at the Xian'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Han was selected to study at the Xian'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年舉人，充景山官學教習。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yongzheng he passed the provincial examination and served as an instructor at the Jingshan official school.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in the tenth year of Yongzheng and served as an instructor at the Jingshan official school.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，授山東榮城知縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he was appointed magistrate of Rongcheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he was appointed magistrate of Rongcheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遷膠州知州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to magistrate of Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to magistrate of Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 在官八年，民頌其惠，築堤曰李堤，立石紀焉。

translations.literal: During eight years in office the people praised his kindness; a dike was built called Li's Dike, and a stone was erected to record it.
translations.idiomatic: During eight years in office the people praised his kindness; they built a dike called Li's Dike and set up a stone to commemorate it.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，擢武定知府。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was promoted to prefect of Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was promoted to prefect of Wuding.

sentences.zh: 大水，乘小舟勘賑，幾溺，卒竟其事。

translations.literal: In a great flood he took a small boat to inspect relief work, nearly drowned, but still completed the task.
translations.idiomatic: During a great flood he took a small boat to inspect relief work, nearly drowned, but still finished the task.

sentences.zh: 徒駭河久塞，請發帑濬治，自是連歲無水患。

translations.literal: The Tuhai River had long been blocked; he requested treasury funds for dredging, and from then on there were no flood disasters for successive years.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuhai River had long been blocked; he requested treasury funds to dredge it, and from then on the region went years without flooding.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，擢袞沂曹道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was promoted to Gun-Yi-Cao Circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he was promoted to intendant of Gun-Yi-Cao Circuit.

sentences.zh: 覈防河諸費，歲節以萬計，而隄益堅。

translations.literal: He audited Yellow River defense expenses, saving tens of thousands each year, while the dikes grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: He audited Yellow River defense expenses, saving tens of thousands of taels each year while the dikes grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，擢江西布政使。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was promoted to Jiangxi provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was promoted to Jiangxi provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 奏請停編審，上諭曰：「丁銀既攤入地糧，滋生人丁，遵康熙五十二年聖祖恩旨，永不加賦。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting cessation of quinquennial household registration reviews; the emperor instructed: "Poll-tax silver has already been folded into land tax; as for new births of population, following the Sacred Ancestor's gracious edict of the fifty-second year of Kangxi, additional levies shall never be imposed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to stop the quinquennial household registration review; the emperor replied, "Poll-tax silver has already been folded into the land tax, and as for new births, following the Sacred Ancestor's gracious edict of the fifty-second year of Kangxi, no additional levy shall ever be imposed.

sentences.zh: 各省民穀細數，督撫年終奏報。

translations.literal: Each province's detailed counts of population and grain are reported yearly by governors and governors-general.
translations.idiomatic: Each province's detailed counts of population and grain are reported at year's end by governors and governors-general.

sentences.zh: 五年編審，不過沿襲虛文，應永行停止。」

translations.literal: The five-year registration review is nothing but inherited empty formality and should be permanently stopped."
translations.idiomatic: The five-year registration review is nothing but inherited empty formality and should be stopped permanently.

sentences.zh: 護巡撫。

translations.literal: He was serving as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was acting governor at the time.

sentences.zh: 戶部用湖南布政使吳虎炳議，禁小錢，並及古錢。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue, adopting the proposal of Hunan Provincial Treasurer Wu Hubing, banned small coins and extended the ban to ancient coins.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue, adopting the proposal of Hunan Provincial Treasurer Wu Hubing, banned small coins and extended the ban to ancient coins as well.

sentences.zh: 瀚奏：「收買小錢二千四百餘斤，古錢僅四十餘斤，前代流傳，銷磨殆盡。

translations.literal: Han memorialized: "In purchasing small coins more than 2,400 jin were collected, and ancient coins only a little over 40 jin—handed down from earlier dynasties, they have nearly all been melted away.
translations.idiomatic: Han memorialized that in purchasing small coins more than 2,400 jin had been collected, while ancient coins amounted to only a little over 40 jin—survivors from earlier dynasties, nearly all melted away.

sentences.zh: 應援兩江總督高晉奏准例，聽民間行使。

translations.literal: Following the precedent approved by the memorial of Governor-General Gao Jin of the Two Jiangs, they should be allowed for use among the people.
translations.idiomatic: Following the precedent approved in Governor-General Gao Jin's memorial for the Two Jiangs, they should be allowed for use among the people.

sentences.zh: 如有私鑄古錢，仍與小錢一例查禁。」

translations.literal: If anyone privately casts ancient coins, they should still be investigated and banned like small coins."
translations.idiomatic: If anyone privately cast ancient coins, they should still be investigated and banned like small coins.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: His view was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 又奏言：「時憲書按省刊載太陽出入、晝夜、節氣時刻。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Official almanacs are published by province with the times of the sun's rising and setting, day and night, and the solar terms.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that official almanacs were published by province with the times of sunrise and sunset, day and night, and the solar terms.

sentences.zh: 今江南分江蘇、安徽，湖廣分湖北、湖南，陝西分甘肅，請添註省名，分晰開載。」

translations.literal: Now Jiangnan is divided into Jiangsu and Anhui, Huguang into Hubei and Hunan, and Shaanxi into Gansu; please add provincial names and set them out separately and clearly."
translations.idiomatic: Now that Jiangnan had been split into Jiangsu and Anhui, Huguang into Hubei and Hunan, and Shaanxi into Gansu, he asked that provincial names be added and the entries set out separately and clearly.

sentences.zh: 如所請行。

translations.literal: It was carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted the request.

sentences.zh: 四十年，授雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was appointed governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he was appointed governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 行至貴州，道卒。

translations.literal: When he reached Guizhou on the road, he died en route.
translations.idiomatic: He died on the road while passing through Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 李世傑，字漢三，貴州黔西人。

translations.literal: Li Shijie, styled Hansan, was a native of Qianxi in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shijie, whose style was Hansan, was a native of Qianxi in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 少倜儻，喜騎射。

translations.literal: In youth he was free-spirited and fond of horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he was bold and free-spirited, and loved riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 年二十餘，折節改行。

translations.literal: When he was a little over twenty, he restrained himself and changed his ways.
translations.idiomatic: In his early twenties he checked his wild habits and turned to a more sober path.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年，入貲為江蘇常熟黃泗浦巡檢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, through purchased office he became river patrol inspector at Huangsipu in Changshu, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9 he bought office and was made river patrol inspector at Huangsipu in Changshu, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 知縣李永書引與同堂聽訟，縣人稱其平。

translations.literal: Magistrate Li Yongshu had him sit in court to hear cases with him, and the county people praised his fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Li Yongshu had him join him on the bench to hear cases, and local people praised his evenhandedness.

sentences.zh: 總督尹繼善、巡撫莊有恭薦卓異，遷金匱主簿。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yin Jishan and Governor Zhuang Yougong recommended him as outstanding, and he was transferred to chief clerk of Jinkui.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yin Jishan and Governor Zhuang Yougong rated him outstanding, and he was transferred to chief clerk of Jinkui.

sentences.zh: 有恭檄充巡捕官，為入貲以知縣留江蘇。

translations.literal: Yougong dispatched him as a patrol and arrest officer; through purchased office he was retained in Jiangsu as a magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Yougong appointed him a patrol and arrest officer, and through purchased office he was kept in Jiangsu as a magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，除泰州知州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was appointed prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 始至，訟未結者四百餘案，晝夜據案視事，不五月報結。

translations.literal: When he first arrived, more than four hundred cases remained unsettled; day and night he sat at his desk handling affairs, and within less than five months all were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: When he first took office, more than four hundred cases were still pending; he worked at his desk day and night and cleared them all in less than five months.

sentences.zh: 巡撫陳宏謀薦堪勝知府。

translations.literal: Governor Chen Hongmou recommended him as fit for the post of prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Chen Hongmou recommended him as qualified for promotion to prefect.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，擢鎮江知府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to prefect of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to prefect of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 上命裁京口駐防漢軍，世傑捐廉集貲，人予餉三月、衣一襲，裁者三千人，皆分畀職役。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the disbandment of Han banner troops stationed at Jingkou; Shijie contributed from his integrity salary to raise funds, giving each man three months' rations and one suit of clothes—the three thousand who were cut were all assigned to various offices.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor ordered the Han banner garrison at Jingkou disbanded, Shijie drew on his own salary to raise funds, giving each man three months' pay and a suit of clothes; the three thousand affected were all placed in other posts.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢安徽寧池太廣道。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to intendant of the Ning-Chi-Tai-Guang circuit in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to intendant of the Ning-Chi-Tai-Guang circuit in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，服闋，三十六年，授四川鹽驛道。

translations.literal: He mourned his father's death; when the mourning period ended, in the thirty-sixth year he was appointed intendant of the Sichuan Salt and Courier circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his father and completing the mourning period, in the thirty-sixth year he was appointed intendant of the Sichuan Salt and Courier circuit.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢按察使。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 師徵金川，總督桂林檄世傑駐打箭爐，督約咱路軍需。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against Jinchuan, Governor Gui Lin ordered Shijie to station at Dajianlu to supervise military supplies along the Zaluo route.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jinchuan campaign, Governor Gui Lin ordered Shijie to station at Dajianlu and supervise military supplies along the Zaluo route.

sentences.zh: 木果木之敗，副將軍阿桂全師暫退，軍中餉銀數万巨錠，募運還，無應者。

translations.literal: After the defeat at Muguamu, Deputy Commander Agui withdrew the whole army for a time; several tens of thousands of ingots of army pay silver were offered for transport back, but no one responded.
translations.idiomatic: After the disaster at Muguamu, Deputy Commander Agui withdrew the entire army for a time; tens of thousands of ingots of army pay were offered for transport back, but no one would take the job.

sentences.zh: 世傑令曰：「委於賊，寧散於民！」

translations.literal: Shijie ordered: "Rather than leave it to the bandits, better scatter it among the people!"
translations.idiomatic: Shijie ordered: "Better to scatter it among the people than leave it to the enemy!

sentences.zh: 從軍貿易者數万人，爭取立盡。

translations.literal: Tens of thousands of people trading with the army seized it all in an instant.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of camp followers and traders snatched it up on the spot.

sentences.zh: 世傑督隊護其後，密檄關吏，見持餉銀入口者皆令還官，鋌酬以給銀五兩，帑獲全。

translations.literal: Shijie led a escort party behind them and secretly instructed the frontier officers that anyone entering with pay silver must return it to the government, with a reward of five taels for each ingot returned; the treasury was made whole.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie led a guard party behind them and secretly ordered frontier officers to require anyone bringing pay silver through the passes to surrender it, offering five taels for each ingot returned; the treasury was fully recovered.

sentences.zh: 師復進，鑄砲缺炭，檄世傑營辦。

translations.literal: When the army advanced again, cannon casting lacked charcoal, and Shijie was ordered to arrange supplies.
translations.idiomatic: When the army advanced again, there was not enough charcoal for casting cannon, and Shijie was ordered to provide it.

sentences.zh: 世傑令伐樹劄木城卡衛，掘地為大窯數十，复伐樹而薪焉。

translations.literal: Shijie ordered trees cut to fortify the wooden stockades at Chengka Wei, dug the ground for several dozen large kilns, and again cut trees for firewood.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie ordered trees felled to reinforce the wooden stockades at Chengka Wei, dug several dozen large kilns in the ground, and felled more trees for fuel.

sentences.zh: 不旬月，炭足供鑄。

translations.literal: Within less than ten days, charcoal was sufficient for casting.
translations.idiomatic: In less than ten days there was enough charcoal for the foundries.

sentences.zh: 守禦僧格宗發敵伏，俘十六人以還。

translations.literal: Defensive officer Sengge Zong launched an ambush on the enemy and returned with sixteen captives.
translations.idiomatic: Defensive officer Sengge Zong sprang an ambush on the enemy and returned with sixteen prisoners.

sentences.zh: 阿桂以聞，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: Agui reported it, and Shijie was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Agui reported the feat, and Shijie was awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四十年，擢湖北布政使，乃留軍督餉。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was promoted to provincial treasurer of Hubei, but remained with the army supervising supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he was promoted to provincial treasurer of Hubei, yet stayed with the army to supervise supplies.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，金川平，乃上官。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, when Jinchuan was pacified, he took up his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, after Jinchuan was pacified, he finally took up his post.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，擢廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，命署湖南巡撫，服闋真除。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he was ordered to serve as acting governor of Hunan; when mourning ended he was formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year he was ordered to serve as acting governor of Hunan, and after mourning was formally appointed.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，調河南。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to Henan.

sentences.zh: 大學士阿桂督塞青龍岡決口，疏引河，上命佔用民田當安頓調濟。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Agui supervised sealing the breach at Qinglonggang and opening a diversion channel; the emperor ordered that requisitioned civilian fields be used for resettlement and relief.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Agui supervised closing the breach at Qinglonggang and opening a diversion channel; the emperor ordered that requisitioned farmland be used for resettlement and relief.

sentences.zh: 世傑尋奏請以北岸涸出地畝，劃給南岸佔用民田。

translations.literal: Shijie soon memorialized requesting that reclaimed fields on the north bank be allotted to compensate fields requisitioned on the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie soon memorialized that reclaimed fields on the north bank should be allotted to compensate farmland requisitioned on the south bank.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，奏引河新築南堤，捐廉種柳，別疏釐定防護新河將吏官制。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he memorialized on the newly built south dike of the diversion channel, contributing from his salary to plant willows, and separately memorialized to fix the official system for officers guarding the new river.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he reported on the newly built south dike of the diversion channel, contributed from his own salary to plant willows, and separately memorialized to define the official system for guarding the new river.

sentences.zh: 遷四川總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四川自軍興後，徵調賦斂無藝，倉庫如洗。

translations.literal: Since military operations began in Sichuan, levies and taxation knew no bounds, and the storehouses were swept bare.
translations.idiomatic: Since the wars began in Sichuan, levies and exactions had known no limit, and the treasuries were empty.

sentences.zh: 世傑潔己率屬，休養生息，俾漸復舊觀，上嘗舉世傑功風厲諸省。

translations.literal: Shijie kept himself clean and led his subordinates by example, allowing rest and recovery so that things gradually returned to their former state; the emperor once cited Shijie's achievement to admonish other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie kept himself incorrupt and led his subordinates by example, letting the province recover by degrees; the emperor once held up his record to spur other provinces.

sentences.zh: 世傑疏劾酉陽知州吳申，州民入湖廣界為盜，不即捕治。

translations.literal: Shijie memorialized impeaching Youyang Prefect Wu Shen because people of the prefecture crossed into Huguang to rob and he did not promptly arrest and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie impeached Youyang Prefect Wu Shen for failing to arrest and punish locals who crossed into Huguang to rob.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「四川盜匪，前此大加懲創，地方安靜，乃復有焚殺搶劫之事，皆世傑因循玩愒所釀成。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Bandits in Sichuan had been severely punished before and the region was quiet; yet burning, killing, and robbery have occurred again—all brought about by Shijie's laxity and negligence."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Banditry in Sichuan had been sharply punished and the region was quiet, yet burning, killing, and robbery have broken out again—all the result of Shijie's laxity and neglect.

sentences.zh: 傳旨申飭。

translations.literal: An edict was sent rebuking him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent rebuking him.

sentences.zh: 甘肅回复亂，世傑奏遣川北總兵富祿率兵赴援，建昌總兵魁麟防昭化、廣元。

translations.literal: When the Hui revolted again in Gansu, Shijie memorialized dispatching Northern Sichuan Regional Commander Fu Lu with troops to aid, and Jianchang Regional Commander Kui Lin to guard Zhaohua and Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hui rose again in Gansu, Shijie memorialized to send Northern Sichuan Regional Commander Fu Lu with troops to assist, and Jianchang Regional Commander Kui Lin to guard Zhaohua and Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 上以回亂漸定，諭世傑鎮靜。

translations.literal: As the Hui rebellion was gradually being pacified, the emperor instructed Shijie to remain calm.
translations.idiomatic: As the Hui rebellion was gradually subsiding, the emperor told Shijie to stay calm.

sentences.zh: 五十年，世傑年七十，入覲，與千叟宴。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, when Shijie was seventy, he came to audience and attended the banquet for a thousand elders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year, at seventy, Shijie came to court and attended the banquet for a thousand elders.

sentences.zh: 州縣捕金川逃兵不力，例奪官，仍留任，準調不准升。

translations.literal: When prefectures and counties failed to capture Jinchuan deserters effectively, by regulation their ranks were stripped yet they remained in office—permitted transfer but not promotion.
translations.idiomatic: When prefectures and counties failed to capture Jinchuan deserters, by regulation their ranks were stripped but they stayed in office—eligible for transfer but not promotion.

sentences.zh: 世傑奏請準令捐复，上嚴斥之，下吏議。

translations.literal: Shijie memorialized requesting permission for them to purchase reinstatement of rank; the emperor sharply rebuked him and referred the matter to officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie memorialized asking that they be allowed to buy back their ranks; the emperor sharply rebuked him and referred the case to officials for review.

sentences.zh: 旋又允陝西巡撫何裕城請，命世傑免議。

translations.literal: Soon after, accepting the request of Shaanxi Governor He Yucheng, the emperor exempted Shijie from deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, accepting Shaanxi Governor He Yucheng's request, the emperor exempted Shijie from review.

sentences.zh: 湖廣飢，告糴於四川，世傑請以近水次諸州縣常平倉穀碾米三十萬石。

translations.literal: When Huguang suffered famine and requested grain from Sichuan, Shijie asked to mill three hundred thousand shi of grain from the ever-normal granaries of prefectures and counties near the waterways.
translations.idiomatic: When Huguang was stricken by famine and asked Sichuan for grain, Shijie proposed milling three hundred thousand shi from the ever-normal granaries of counties near the waterways.

sentences.zh: 既，浙江亦告糶，世傑以浙江視湖廣遠，運米濟賑，緩且不及；

translations.literal: Afterward Zhejiang also requested grain for sale; Shijie held that Zhejiang was farther than Huguang, and transporting rice for relief would be slow and too late;
translations.idiomatic: Then Zhejiang also asked for grain; Shijie argued that Zhejiang was farther than Huguang, and shipping rice there would be too slow to help;

sentences.zh: 又請以備應湖廣糴米，撥十萬石先濟浙江。

translations.literal: he further requested that of the rice prepared for Huguang, one hundred thousand shi be diverted first to relieve Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: he further asked that one hundred thousand shi of the rice set aside for Huguang be sent first to relieve Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上嘉世傑得封疆大臣體，命議敘。

translations.literal: The emperor commended Shijie for understanding the bearing of a frontier grandee and ordered a record of merit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Shijie for showing the judgment of a frontier grandee and ordered his service recorded for reward.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，調江南總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year he was transferred to governor-general of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year he was transferred to governor-general of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 世傑遘疾，乞解任，上不許。

translations.literal: Shijie fell ill and requested relief from office, but the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie fell ill and asked to resign, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 秋大雨，河決司家莊。

translations.literal: In autumn heavy rains caused the river to breach at Sijiazhuang.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn heavy rains broke the river at Sijiazhuang.

sentences.zh: 偕安徽巡撫書麟、河道總督李奉翰籌工費，請開捐例。

translations.literal: Together with Anhui Governor Shu Lin and Director-General of Rivers Li Fenghan he calculated project costs and requested opening a sale-of-office quota.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Anhui Governor Shu Lin and Director-General of Rivers Li Fenghan he calculated the cost of the works and asked to open a sale-of-office quota.

sentences.zh: 上諭之曰：「戶部庫銀尚存七千餘萬，帑藏充盈，足敷供億。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed him: "The Ministry of Revenue still holds more than seventy million taels in the treasury; the coffers are full and sufficient for all needs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "The Ministry of Revenue still holds more than seventy million taels; the treasury is full and more than adequate.

sentences.zh: 世傑何必為此鰓鰓言利之舉？

translations.literal: Why must Shijie resort to this anxious talk of profit?
translations.idiomatic: Why must Shijie resort to this grasping talk of profit?

sentences.zh: 捐納未嘗無人才，而庸流因之並進博膴仕。

translations.literal: Purchased office has not been without talent, yet mediocre men have also entered thereby to pursue fat official posts.
translations.idiomatic: Purchased office has produced able men, but mediocrities have also used it to buy their way into lucrative posts.

sentences.zh: 一二年後，得廉俸過於所出，國家並無實際，銓政官方，兩無裨益。

translations.literal: After a year or two their integrity salaries exceed what they paid in; the state gains nothing in fact, and neither personnel policy nor official standards is helped.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year or two their salaries exceed what they paid in; the state gains nothing, and neither appointments nor official standards are improved.

sentences.zh: 此奏不可行。」

translations.literal: This memorial cannot be approved."
translations.idiomatic: This proposal cannot be accepted.

sentences.zh: 尋復命大學士阿桂蒞工，及冬，工乃竟。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Grand Secretary Agui was again ordered to oversee the works, and by winter the project was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Agui was then ordered to take charge of the works, and by winter the project was finished.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，狼山鎮陳杰疏言各營火藥短少，上命察覈。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year Chen Jie of Langshan garrison memorialized that gunpowder in the various camps was short; the emperor ordered an investigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year Chen Jie of Langshan garrison reported that gunpowder was short in the various camps, and the emperor ordered an inquiry.

sentences.zh: 世傑奏：「鎮屬鹽城等五營硝磺缺額，磺產山西，例二年一次採運。

translations.literal: Shijie memorialized: "In the five camps under the garrison, including Yancheng, saltpeter and sulfur were below quota; sulfur is produced in Shanxi and by regulation is mined and transported once every two years.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie reported: "In the garrison's five camps, including Yancheng, saltpeter and sulfur were below quota; sulfur comes from Shanxi and by regulation is mined and shipped every two years.

sentences.zh: 近因運使歲需煙盒，磺銀催解不前，不能如例，以致支絀。」

translations.literal: Recently, because the transport commissioner each year required fireworks boxes, sulfur funds were not forwarded in time and the quota could not be met, causing the shortfall."
translations.idiomatic: Lately, because the transport commissioner each year required fireworks tribute, sulfur payments lagged and quotas could not be met, causing the shortfall.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「硝磺軍火要需，向俱採辦足額。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Saltpeter and sulfur are essential military supplies, and quotas have always been fully procured.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Saltpeter and sulfur are essential military supplies, and quotas have always been fully met.

sentences.zh: 以兩江而論，安徽據奏足額，何獨江蘇短缺？

translations.literal: Taking the Two Jiangs, Anhui according to reports met the quota—why is Jiangsu alone short?
translations.idiomatic: In the Two Jiangs, Anhui reportedly met its quota—why is Jiangsu alone short?

sentences.zh: 兩淮年例，歲不過煙盒七架、大小爆竹一萬，所需能幾？

translations.literal: The Two Huai annual quota is no more than seven sets of fireworks boxes and ten thousand firecrackers large and small—how much can that require?
translations.idiomatic: The Two Huai annual quota is only seven sets of fireworks and ten thousand firecrackers—how much can that take?

sentences.zh: 有司採運遲延，以此卸罪。

translations.literal: Local officials delayed procurement and transport and used this as an excuse.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials delayed procurement and used this as an excuse.

sentences.zh: 世傑以此率涉支飾，令兩淮鹽政徵瑞會同料理。」

translations.literal: The emperor held that Shijie was largely making evasive excuses and ordered Salt Controller Zheng Rui of the Two Huai to handle the matter jointly."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Shijie was largely making excuses and ordered Two Huai Salt Controller Zheng Rui to handle the matter with him.

sentences.zh: 世傑尋劾江寧布政使袁鑑於各屬磺價尚未解齊，誤將運使煙盒價牽敘，下吏議。

translations.literal: Shijie soon impeached Jiangning Provincial Treasurer Yuan Jian because sulfur prices in the subordinate districts had not all been forwarded, yet he had wrongly included the transport commissioner's fireworks costs in the account; the matter was referred to officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie soon impeached Jiangning Provincial Treasurer Yuan Jian because sulfur payments from the subordinate districts were incomplete, yet he had wrongly lumped in the transport commissioner's fireworks costs; the case was sent to officials for review.

sentences.zh: 又以河督題報葦蕩營新淤灘地產柴數與案不符，責世傑未察覈；

translations.literal: The emperor also noted that the Director-General of Rivers reported that the firewood yield from newly silted shoals of the Reed Marsh garrison did not match the records, and blamed Shijie for failing to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also noted that the Director-General of Rivers reported that firewood yields from newly silted shoals of the Reed Marsh garrison did not match the records, and blamed Shijie for failing to investigate;

sentences.zh: 世傑复偕徵瑞奏言硝磺缺額，由採運稽遲，請將歷任布政使議處。

translations.literal: Shijie again jointly memorialized with Zheng Rui that the saltpeter and sulfur shortfall was due to delayed procurement and transport, and requested that successive provincial treasurers be subject to deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie again reported jointly with Zheng Rui that the shortfall was due to delayed procurement and asked that successive provincial treasurers be punished.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「世傑等本當治罪，但以事涉上供，從寬降鑑江寧知府，停世傑養廉三年。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Shijie and the others should have been punished, but because the matter involved tribute to the throne, leniency was shown: Yuan Jian was demoted to prefect of Jiangning, and Shijie's integrity salary was suspended for three years."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Shijie and the others deserved punishment, but because the matter involved imperial tribute, leniency was shown: Yuan Jian was demoted to prefect of Jiangning, and Shijie's integrity salary was suspended for three years.

sentences.zh: 並罷兩淮例進煙盒、爆竹。

translations.literal: The annual tribute of fireworks boxes and firecrackers from the Two Huai was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The annual tribute of fireworks and firecrackers from the Two Huai was also abolished.

sentences.zh: 復調四川總督。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred back to governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，巴勒布夷為亂，據西藏屬聶拉木、濟嚨。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year the Gurkhas rebelled and occupied Nyalam and Gyirong, dependencies of Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year the Gurkhas rebelled and seized Nyalam and Gyirong in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 上命世傑撥駐防綠營及明正、巴塘、里塘、德爾革爾諸土司兵赴西藏；

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Shijie to dispatch Green Standard garrison troops and tribal forces of Mingzheng, Batang, Litang, De'ergai'er, and other chiefs to Tibet;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Shijie to send Green Standard garrison troops and tribal forces from Mingzheng, Batang, Litang, De'ergai'er, and other chiefs to Tibet;

sentences.zh: 而世傑得駐藏大臣慶林牒，已發駐防綠營兵及屯練降番合三千人，令提督成德等率以行。

translations.literal: But Shijie received a dispatch from the Resident Commissioner in Tibet, Qing Lin, stating that three thousand Green Standard garrison troops and trained surrendered tribesmen had already been sent under Regional Commander Cheng De and others.
translations.idiomatic: But Shijie received a dispatch from Tibet Resident Commissioner Qing Lin saying that three thousand Green Standard garrison troops and trained surrendered tribesmen had already been sent under Regional Commander Cheng De and others.

sentences.zh: 奏入，上命毋發明正、巴塘、里塘、德爾革爾諸土司兵。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor ordered that tribal troops of Mingzheng, Batang, Litang, De'ergai'er, and the other chiefs not be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor ordered that tribal troops from Mingzheng, Batang, Litang, De'ergai'er, and the other chiefs not be sent.

sentences.zh: 世傑奏：「奏諭已令諸土司發兵，諸土司近尚安靜。

translations.literal: Shijie memorialized: "The imperial instruction had already ordered the tribal chiefs to send troops, and the chiefs have lately remained quiet.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie reported: "Your instruction had already ordered the tribal chiefs to send troops, and they have lately remained quiet.

sentences.zh: 既調复停，恐番性生疑，仍令備調。」

translations.literal: Having been mobilized and then halted, I fear the tribesmen may grow suspicious; please let them remain on standby."
translations.idiomatic: Having been mobilized and then stopped, I fear the tribesmen may grow suspicious; I ask that they remain on standby.

sentences.zh: 上嘉世傑相機妥辦，不拘泥遵旨，解禦佩大小荷包賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended Shijie for handling matters appropriately as circumstances required without rigidly adhering to the letter of the edict, and bestowed on him large and small purses from the imperial wardrobe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Shijie for handling the matter appropriately without rigidly obeying the letter of the edict, and gave him large and small purses from the imperial wardrobe.

sentences.zh: 世傑又奏發米萬三千三百石運西藏，足敷兵食。

translations.literal: Shijie also memorialized dispatching thirteen thousand three hundred shi of rice to Tibet, sufficient for the army's provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie also reported sending thirteen thousand three hundred shi of rice to Tibet, enough to feed the troops.

sentences.zh: 上褒世傑盡心，命移駐打箭爐。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Shijie's devoted service and ordered him to move his headquarters to Dajianlu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Shijie's dedication and ordered him to move his headquarters to Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 迭疏報成都將軍鄂輝率兵千二百入藏，副將那蘇圖率屯練五百駐打箭爐。

translations.literal: In successive memorials he reported that Chengdu General E Hui led twelve hundred troops into Tibet, and Vice Commander Nasutu led five hundred trained militia stationed at Dajianlu.
translations.idiomatic: In successive reports he stated that Chengdu General E Hui had led twelve hundred troops into Tibet and Vice Commander Nasutu five hundred trained militia stationed at Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 尋以巴勒布夷遠遁，諭世傑還成都。

translations.literal: Soon, as the Gurkhas had fled far away, the emperor instructed Shijie to return to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, as the Gurkhas had fled far away, the emperor told Shijie to return to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，秋審，四川原定緩決、刑部改情實者凡七案。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, at the autumn review of capital cases, there were seven cases in which Sichuan had originally fixed deferred execution but the Ministry of Justice changed them to circumstances warranting execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year, at the autumn review, there were seven cases in which Sichuan had originally deferred execution but the Ministry of Justice changed them to capital verdicts.

sentences.zh: 上責世傑寬縱，以其老，且平日治事覈實，免議。

translations.literal: The emperor blamed Shijie for leniency, but because of his age and because his usual handling of affairs was thorough, he was exempted from deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Shijie for being too lenient, but because of his age and his usual thoroughness in office, he was exempted from review.

sentences.zh: 世傑薦川北道明安，引見，上以其年衰，改主事，世傑下吏議。

translations.literal: Shijie recommended Northern Sichuan Circuit Intendant Ming An for audience; the emperor, finding him aged, changed his appointment to secretary and referred Shijie to officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie recommended Northern Sichuan Circuit Intendant Ming An for audience; the emperor, finding him too old, made him a secretary instead and referred Shijie to officials for review.

sentences.zh: 世傑以病請解任，上令侍衛慶成偕醫診視，賜人葠，並令自審病輕則來京，重則回籍。

translations.literal: Shijie requested relief from office on grounds of illness; the emperor ordered Bodyguard Qing Cheng to accompany a physician to examine him, granted ginseng, and told him to judge for himself—if the illness was mild, come to the capital; if severe, return home.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie asked to resign because of illness; the emperor sent Bodyguard Qing Cheng with a physician to examine him, granted ginseng, and told him to decide for himself—if the illness was mild, come to the capital; if severe, return home.

sentences.zh: 五十五年三月，入覲，授兵部尚書，賜紫禁城乘肩輿。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifty-fifth year he came to audience, was appointed Minister of War, and was granted use of a sedan chair in the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifty-fifth year he came to court, was appointed Minister of War, and was granted the use of a sedan chair in the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 江蘇句容吏侵蝕錢糧漕米，上責世傑在兩江未覺察，命以原品休致回籍。

translations.literal: Officials in Jurong, Jiangsu, had embezzled tax grain and tribute rice; the emperor blamed Shijie for failing to detect it while in the Two Jiangs and ordered him to retire at his original rank and return home.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in Jurong, Jiangsu, had embezzled tax grain and tribute rice; the emperor blamed Shijie for failing to detect it while governing the Two Jiangs and ordered him to retire at his original rank and return home.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，卒，年七十九，賜祭葬，諡恭勤。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he died at the age of seventy-nine; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, and he was given the posthumous title Gongqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he died at seventy-nine; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, and he was posthumously titled Gongqin.

sentences.zh: 世傑仕而後學，摘發鉤距，必得要領。

translations.literal: Shijie studied after taking office; in probing and comparing cases he always grasped the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie studied after entering office, yet in probing cases and weighing evidence he always hit the essentials.

sentences.zh: 上每言其不通文理，然屢褒其能事，禮遇優厚。

translations.literal: The emperor often said he was deficient in literary cultivation, yet repeatedly praised his competence and treated him with exceptional favor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor often said he lacked literary polish, yet repeatedly praised his ability and treated him with exceptional favor.

sentences.zh: 世傑長子漳州知府華國早卒，上降詔慰勉。

translations.literal: Shijie's eldest son Huaguo, prefect of Zhangzhou, died early; the emperor issued an edict of consolation.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie's eldest son Huaguo, prefect of Zhangzhou, died young; the emperor issued an edict of consolation.

sentences.zh: 其孫舉人再瀛，會試未中式，令一體殿試，授禮部主事。

translations.literal: His grandson, presented scholar Zaiying, had not passed the metropolitan examination; he was ordered to take the palace examination along with the others and was appointed secretary in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson, presented scholar Zaiying, had failed the metropolitan examination; he was nevertheless ordered to take the palace examination with the others and was appointed secretary in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 及世傑入為尚書，再瀛病卒，召其次子知州華封授員外郎，俾奉侍。

translations.literal: When Shijie entered the capital as minister, Zaiying died of illness; his second son Huafeng, then serving as prefect, was summoned and granted the rank of vice director so that he might attend and serve.
translations.idiomatic: When Shijie came to the capital as minister, Zaiying died of illness; the emperor summoned his second son Huafeng, then serving as prefect, granted him the rank of vice director, and had him attend his father.

sentences.zh: 華封官至兩廣鹽運使。

translations.literal: Huafeng rose in office to salt transport commissioner of the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng eventually reached the post of salt transport commissioner of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 袁守侗，字執衝，山東長山人。

translations.literal: Yuan Shoudong, styled Zhichong, was a native of Changshan in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shoudong, whose style was Zhichong, came from Changshan in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年舉人，入貲授內閣中書，充軍機處章京。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the ninth year of Qianlong, he purchased entry and was appointed a drafter in the Grand Secretariat, serving as a clerk in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the provincial examination in the ninth year of Qianlong, he bought office and was appointed a Grand Secretariat drafter, then served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 遷侍讀。

translations.literal: He was promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 再遷吏部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 考選江西道御史，授浙江鹽驛道。

translations.literal: Selected through examination as censor of the Jiangxi Circuit, he was appointed intendant of the Zhejiang Salt and Post Office Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen by examination as censor of the Jiangxi Circuit, he was appointed intendant of the Zhejiang Salt and Post Office Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，遷廣西按察使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was made provincial surveillance commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「煙瘴充軍人皆凶悍，請分撥泗城、鎮安、寧明、東蘭諸地；

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Those banished to military exile in miasma regions are all fierce and unruly; I request distributing them among Sicheng, Zhen'an, Ningming, Donglan, and other districts;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Those banished to military exile in the miasma regions are all fierce and unruly; I request that they be distributed among Sicheng, Zhen'an, Ningming, Donglan, and other districts;

sentences.zh: 解役疏脫斬絞重囚，短解問徒，長解問流；

translations.literal: If escort guards are lax and a prisoner sentenced to decapitation or strangulation escapes, the short escort is questioned for penal servitude and the long escort for exile;
translations.idiomatic: If escort guards are lax and a prisoner condemned to decapitation or strangulation escapes, the short escort is punished with penal servitude and the long escort with exile;

sentences.zh: 各署書役貼寫幫差，濫收滋弊，請量定多寡，分別汰留。」

translations.literal: In each office clerks and runners assist by transcribing and serving on escort duty, and indiscriminate hiring breeds abuse; I request fixing quotas and culling or retaining accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: In every office clerks and runners help with transcription and escort duty, and indiscriminate hiring breeds abuse; I request that quotas be set and surplus staff culled or retained as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 又言：「卓異官，籓、臬、道、府甫到任未三月​​，停止出結。」

translations.literal: He also said: "For outstanding-merit nominations, if governors-general, provincial surveillance commissioners, circuit intendants, or prefects have been in office less than three months, cease issuing certification."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "For outstanding-merit nominations, if a governor-general, surveillance commissioner, circuit intendant, or prefect has been in office less than three months, no certification should be issued."

sentences.zh: 部議均從之。

translations.literal: The Board deliberated and approved all proposals.
translations.idiomatic: The Board approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，丁父憂，服闋，命以三品京堂仍充軍機章京，補太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, upon his father's death, when mourning ended he was ordered to serve again as a Grand Council clerk with third-rank status in the capital, and was appointed vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, after his father's death and the mourning period, he was ordered to resume service as a Grand Council clerk at third rank in the capital and was appointed vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 遷吏部侍郎，調刑部。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel and transferred to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of Personnel and transferred to Justice.

sentences.zh: 命如雲南按布政使錢度貪婪狀，論如律。

translations.literal: He was ordered to follow the Yunnan surveillance commissioner's report on Provincial Treasurer Qian Du's corruption and sentence according to law.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to follow the Yunnan surveillance commissioner's findings on Provincial Treasurer Qian Du's corruption and punish him as the law required.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，兼署禮部，命在軍機大臣上學習行走，兼管順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he served concurrently as acting minister of Rites, was ordered to study and serve under the Grand Council ministers, and was given concurrent charge of the Shuntian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year he served concurrently as acting minister of Rites, was assigned to study under the Grand Council ministers, and was given charge of the Shuntian prefect as well.

sentences.zh: 復命如雲南按保山知縣王錫供給總督彰寶虧空兵糧，論如律。

translations.literal: Again he was ordered to follow the Yunnan surveillance commissioner's report that Baoshan Magistrate Wang Xi had supplied Governor-General Zhang Bao while creating a shortfall in military provisions, and sentence according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Again he was ordered to follow the Yunnan surveillance commissioner's findings that Baoshan Magistrate Wang Xi had supplied Governor-General Zhang Bao while creating a shortfall in military provisions, and punish him as the law required.

sentences.zh: 調吏部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Personnel.

sentences.zh: 又命如貴州按總督圖思德劾鎮遠知府蘇墧貪婪狀，罪至死。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to follow the Guizhou surveillance commissioner's report on Governor-General Tusi De's impeachment of Zhenyuan Prefect Su Shan for corruption, with punishment up to death.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered to follow the Guizhou surveillance commissioner's findings on Governor-General Tusi De's impeachment of Zhenyuan Prefect Su Shan for corruption, with punishment up to death.

sentences.zh: 暫署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: He served temporarily as acting governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served temporarily as acting governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 又如四川按松岡站員冀谷勳侵蝕軍米，論如律。

translations.literal: Again, following the Sichuan surveillance commissioner's report that Songgang station officer Ji Guxun had embezzled military grain, he sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Again, following the Sichuan surveillance commissioner's findings that Songgang station officer Ji Guxun had embezzled military grain, he punished the offender as the law required.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，遷戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year he was transferred to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year he was made Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 復命如四川按富德濫用犒軍銀，即監詣京師，賜黑狐端罩。

translations.literal: Again he was ordered to follow the Sichuan surveillance commissioner's report that Fu De had misused army reward funds; Fu De was escorted immediately to the capital under guard, and Shoudong was granted a black-fox surcoat.
translations.idiomatic: Again he was ordered to follow the Sichuan surveillance commissioner's findings that Fu De had misused army reward funds; Fu De was escorted straight to the capital under guard, and Shoudong was granted a black-fox surcoat.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year he was transferred to Justice.

sentences.zh: 命如甘肅勘驗捐收監糧。

translations.literal: He was ordered to follow Gansu in examining donated grain collected for granary storage.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to follow Gansu in inspecting donated grain collected for granary storage.

sentences.zh: 復命偕兩江總督高晉籌堵儀封漫口。

translations.literal: Again he was ordered, together with Two Jiangs Governor-General Gao Jin, to plan blocking the Yifeng breach.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered, together with Two Jiangs Governor-General Gao Jin, to plan repairs at the Yifeng breach.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，奏言遵兜袖法築兩壩，以期回溜分入引河。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he memorialized that following the douxiu method two dams should be built so that returning currents could be divided into the diversion channel.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he memorialized that, following the douxiu method, two dams should be built so that returning currents could be split into the diversion channel.

sentences.zh: 又與高晉會奏引河頭去口門稍遠，開引溝三百餘丈，直達引河，繪圖奏聞。

translations.literal: Together with Gao Jin he jointly memorialized that the head of the diversion channel was somewhat far from the gate mouth; a diversion trench more than three hundred zhang long should be opened straight to the diversion channel, and a diagram submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Gao Jin he jointly memorialized that the head of the diversion channel lay somewhat far from the gate mouth, that a diversion trench more than three hundred zhang long should be opened straight to the channel, and submitted a diagram.

sentences.zh: 上以所擬引河向南，恐紆回不能得勢，於圖內硃筆標識，令向北改直。

translations.literal: The emperor, fearing that the proposed diversion channel running south would loop back and fail to gain force, marked it in red on the diagram and ordered it straightened to the north.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, fearing that the proposed diversion channel running south would loop back and fail to gain force, marked it in red on the diagram and ordered it straightened northward.

sentences.zh: 尋奏壩工蟄陷，兩壩鑲築兜收。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized that the dam works had subsided; both dams were edged and built up with collecting aprons.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he reported that the dam works had subsided and had both dams edged and built up with collecting aprons.

sentences.zh: 遵諭將引河頭西首淤灘切去，俾溝口向西北，開寬，引溜下注。

translations.literal: Following the instruction he cut away the silt bar at the west end of the diversion-channel head, widened the trench mouth toward the northwest, and drew the current down.
translations.idiomatic: Following the instruction he cut away the silt bar at the west end of the diversion-channel head, widened the trench mouth toward the northwest, and drew the current down.

sentences.zh: 是年四月，授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year he was appointed Governor-General of the Eastern Henan River conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year he was appointed Governor-General of the Eastern Henan River conservancy.

sentences.zh: 調直隸總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，疏請修築北運河筐兒港減水石壩。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he memorialized requesting construction of a stone spillway dam at Kuang'ergang on the Northern Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he memorialized to build a stone spillway dam at Kuang'ergang on the Northern Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，甘肅監糧舞弊成大獄，上以守侗勘驗不實，下吏議，奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year a major case of fraud in Gansu granary grain collection arose; because Shoudong's inspection had been inadequate the emperor referred him to officials for deliberation, stripped his rank, but ordered him to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year a major fraud case arose in Gansu granary grain collection; because Shoudong's inspection had been inadequate the emperor referred him to officials for review, stripped his rank, but ordered him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，去官。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death he left office.
translations.idiomatic: Upon his mother's death he left office.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，諭勘浚伊家河，疏山東積水。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was instructed to inspect dredging of the Yijia River and drain Shandong's standing water.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he was instructed to inspect dredging of the Yijia River and drain Shandong's standing water.

sentences.zh: 守侗詣勘，奏請自善橋以北抵楊家樓，長七千餘丈，展寬浚深，堵築缺口，拆改礙水橋座，諭速行辦理。

translations.literal: Shoudong went to inspect and memorialized that from Shangqiao north to Yangjialou, more than seven thousand zhang in length, the channel should be widened and deepened, breaches blocked and built up, and obstructing bridges altered; the emperor ordered prompt action.
translations.idiomatic: Shoudong went to inspect and memorialized that from Shangqiao north to Yangjialou, more than seven thousand zhang in length, the channel should be widened and deepened, breaches blocked, and obstructing bridges altered; the emperor ordered prompt action.

sentences.zh: 尋复授直隸總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was again appointed Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again appointed Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，卒，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡清愨。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he died; was posthumously given Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, and given the posthumous title Qingque.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he died; he was posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, and given the posthumous title Qingque.

sentences.zh: 鄭大進，字退谷，廣東揭陽人。

translations.literal: Zheng Dajin, styled Tuigu, was a native of Jieyang in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Dajin, whose style was Tuigu, came from Jieyang in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the first year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 授直隸肥鄉知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Feixiang in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Feixiang in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 累遷山東濟東道。

translations.literal: He was promoted in stages to Jidong Circuit intendant in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to Jidong Circuit intendant in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，山東淫雨，高唐、茌平諸縣水漲阻道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year incessant rain in Shandong flooded Gaotang, Chiping, and other counties and blocked the roads.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year incessant rain in Shandong flooded Gaotang, Chiping, and other counties and blocked the roads.

sentences.zh: 大進相度宣洩，水不為患。

translations.literal: Dajin surveyed and arranged drainage and discharge, and the water caused no harm.
translations.idiomatic: Dajin surveyed the terrain and arranged drainage, and the water caused no further harm.

sentences.zh: 巡撫崔應階薦其能，遷兩淮鹽運使。

translations.literal: Governor Cui Yingjie recommended his ability and he was transferred to salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Cui Yingjie recommended his ability, and he was transferred to salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，丁父憂，去官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, upon his father's death, he left office.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, upon his father's death, he left office.

sentences.zh: 服除，上召至熱河，命署浙江按察使。

translations.literal: When mourning ended the emperor summoned him to Rehe and appointed him acting provincial surveillance commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended the emperor summoned him to Rehe and appointed him acting provincial surveillance commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 尋授湖南按察使。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed provincial surveillance commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed provincial surveillance commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 四十年，遷貴州布政使。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was transferred to provincial treasurer of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he was made provincial treasurer of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，授河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he was appointed governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year he was appointed governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，調湖北。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he was transferred to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he was transferred to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 旋署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Soon he served as acting governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as acting governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 奏：「安陸、荊州二府濱臨江、漢，以堤為衛。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The two prefectures of Anlu and Jingzhou border the Yangzi and Han rivers and rely on dikes for protection.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The two prefectures of Anlu and Jingzhou border the Yangzi and Han rivers and rely on dikes for protection.

sentences.zh: 今夏漲發，鍾祥、潛江、荊門、江陵堤決，已一律修復，惟潛江長一垸地窪沙積，築堤難固，應擇地勢較高處築月堤。

translations.literal: This summer's flood burst the dikes at Zhongxiang, Qianjiang, Jingmen, and Jiangling; all have been repaired, but in Qianjiang's Changyi polder the land is low and sand has accumulated, making dikes hard to hold; crescent dikes should be built on higher ground.
translations.idiomatic: This summer's flood burst the dikes at Zhongxiang, Qianjiang, Jingmen, and Jiangling; all have been repaired, but in Qianjiang's Changyi polder the land is low and sand has accumulated, making dikes hard to hold, so crescent dikes should be built on higher ground.

sentences.zh: 鍾祥、永興、保安諸垸地當衝，亦應築月堤，俾水發江寬，不致出險。

translations.literal: The polders of Zhongxiang, Yongxing, and Bao'an lie in the main current and should also have crescent dikes built so that when the river rises and widens danger may be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: The polders of Zhongxiang, Yongxing, and Bao'an lie in the main current and should also have crescent dikes built so that when the river rises and widens, danger may be avoided.

sentences.zh: 又有劉家巷隄應並修築。」

translations.literal: The dike at Liujiaxiang should also be repaired."
translations.idiomatic: The dike at Liujiaxiang should also be repaired."

sentences.zh: 四十五年，奏：「武昌濱江上游，諸水匯流，繞城而東。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he memorialized: "Upstream along the river at Wuchang, various waters converge and flow east around the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he memorialized: "Upstream along the river at Wuchang, various waters converge and flow east around the city.

sentences.zh: 江漲沖刷，堤根虛懸。

translations.literal: When the river rises it scours away the bank, leaving the dike roots suspended over empty space.
translations.idiomatic: When the river rises it scours away the bank, leaving the dike roots hanging unsupported.

sentences.zh: 現修武昌城畢，請並修堤，毋使水齧城。」

translations.literal: Now that repairs to Wuchang city are finished, I request that the dikes be repaired as well so that water may not gnaw at the city."
translations.idiomatic: Now that repairs to Wuchang city are finished, I request that the dikes be repaired as well so that the water may not undermine the city."

sentences.zh: 均從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏言：「湖廣邪教為害，總督班第奏請枷責發落，俾免株連。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Heretical sects in Huguang were causing harm; Governor-General Bandi memorialized that cangue punishment and release would spare implicating the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Heretical sects in Huguang were causing harm; Governor-General Bandi had memorialized that cangue punishment and release would spare implicating the innocent.

sentences.zh: 牧令遂視為自理詞訟，率不通詳。

translations.literal: District magistrates then treated these as ordinary cases they could settle themselves and generally did not report in detail.
translations.idiomatic: District magistrates then treated these as ordinary cases they could settle themselves and generally failed to report them in detail.

sentences.zh: 請自今以後，據實呈院司覈辦，諱匿徇縱者劾之。」

translations.literal: I request that from now on cases be reported truthfully to the provincial administration and surveillance offices for verification and disposition, and that those who conceal or indulge offenders be impeached."
translations.idiomatic: I request that from now on cases be reported truthfully to the provincial administration and surveillance offices for review and disposition, and that those who conceal or indulge offenders be impeached."

sentences.zh: 上韙其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，授直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he was appointed Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year he was appointed Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 命勘永定河工。

translations.literal: He was ordered to inspect Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to inspect Yongding River works.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「六工以下河身內舊有民居，乾隆十五年給價遷移。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Below the sixth works section there were formerly dwellings within the river bed; in the fifteenth year of Qianlong compensation was paid and residents were relocated.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Below the sixth works section there were formerly dwellings within the river bed; in the fifteenth year of Qianlong compensation was paid and residents were relocated.

sentences.zh: 又以下口改流，奏令暫回繳原給房價，減糧田畝，依舊徵收。

translations.literal: When the lower outlet was later shifted, it was memorialized that compensation already paid should be temporarily recovered and reduced-tax fields taxed again as before.
translations.idiomatic: When the lower outlet was later shifted, it was memorialized that compensation already paid should be temporarily recovered and reduced-tax fields taxed again as before.

sentences.zh: 今勘南、北兩岸，自頭工至六工，村落已盡遷移。

translations.literal: On inspection of both north and south banks from the first works to the sixth, all villages have been relocated.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection of both north and south banks from the first works to the sixth, all villages have been relocated.

sentences.zh: 六工以下，水勢遷徙靡常，累將北埝改築展寬。

translations.literal: Below the sixth works the watercourse shifts constantly; the northern levee has repeatedly been rebuilt and widened.
translations.idiomatic: Below the sixth works the watercourse shifts constantly, and the northern levee has repeatedly been rebuilt and widened.

sentences.zh: 南、北兩堤遙隔五十餘裡，其中居民五十餘村，水漲以船為家，應令遷移。

translations.literal: North and south dikes are separated by more than fifty li; more than fifty villages lie between them and live on boats when water rises; they should be relocated.
translations.idiomatic: North and south dikes are separated by more than fifty li; more than fifty villages lie between them and live on boats when the water rises, and they should be relocated.

sentences.zh: 永清柳坨諸村、東安孫家坨諸村旗、民二百八戶，已勘定地址，令陸續移居。

translations.literal: In Yongqing at Liutuo and other villages and in Dong'an at Sunjiatuo and other villages, two hundred eight banner and commoner households have had sites surveyed and been ordered to move in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongqing at Liutuo and other villages and in Dong'an at Sunjiatuo and other villages, two hundred eight banner and commoner households have had sites surveyed and been ordered to move in sequence.

sentences.zh: 河身較遠之村，仍準暫住。

translations.literal: Villages farther from the river bed may still be allowed to remain temporarily.
translations.idiomatic: Villages farther from the river bed may still be allowed to remain temporarily.

sentences.zh: 禁築壩修房，以杜佔居。」

translations.literal: Building dams and houses is forbidden to prevent encroachment."
translations.idiomatic: Building dams and houses is forbidden to prevent encroachment."

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: The report was noted.
translations.idiomatic: The report was noted.

sentences.zh: 四十七年二月，賜孔雀翎、黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the second month of the forty-seventh year he was granted peacock feathers and a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the forty-seventh year he was granted peacock feathers and a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 五月，奏保定九龍河經清苑、安州至任丘入淀，年久積淤。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he memorialized that the Jiulong River at Baoding runs through Qingyuan and Anzhou to Renqiu and enters the marshes, and has long silted up.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he memorialized that the Jiulong River at Baoding runs through Qingyuan and Anzhou to Renqiu and enters the marshes, and has long silted up.

sentences.zh: 請舊有望都鄉閘、殷家營、高嶺村三閘外，於望都樊村建石閘一，清苑冉村、鄧村、營頭建石閘三。

translations.literal: He requested that besides the three existing sluices at Wangdu Xiang, Yinjiaying, and Gaolingcun, one stone sluice be built at Fancun in Wangdu and three at Rancun, Dengcun, and Yingtou in Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that besides the three existing sluices at Wangdu Xiang, Yinjiaying, and Gaolingcun, one stone sluice be built at Fancun in Wangdu and three at Rancun, Dengcun, and Yingtou in Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 並修整諸舊閘，開濬安州、新安、任丘諸縣河。

translations.literal: Existing sluices should also be repaired and rivers in Anzhou, Xin'an, Renqiu, and other counties dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Existing sluices should also be repaired and rivers in Anzhou, Xin'an, Renqiu, and other counties dredged.

sentences.zh: 皆稱旨，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: All pleased the emperor, and he was given the additional title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: All pleased the emperor, and he was given the additional title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 卒，賜祭葬，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: He died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, and he was given the posthumous title Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: He died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, and he was posthumously titled Qinke.

sentences.zh: 劉峨，字先資，山東單縣人。

translations.literal: Liu E, styled Xianzi, was a native of Shan County in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu E, whose style was Xianzi, came from Shan County in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 入貲授知縣。

translations.literal: He purchased entry and was appointed magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He bought office and was appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年，選直隸曲陽知縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong he was selected as magistrate of Quyang in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong he was selected as magistrate of Quyang in Zhili.
